logical_pattern.description: For each PortInterfaceMapping that is applied (pimApplied), there must exist at least one SwConnector (assembly, delegation, or pass-through) whose MAPPING-REF resolves to that PortInterfaceMapping.
Each ComMgrUserNeeds that has a SWC-SERVICE-DEPENDENCY is associated with exactly one PORT-GROUP via REPRESENTED-PORT-GROUP-REF.
Exactly one of uses_ComM_CS, uses_ComM_Mode, uses_BswM_Mode holds for each PN-BSW-USER.
For each SW-COMPONENT, at least one of uses_ComM_CS_Retrieval or uses_ComM_SR_Retrieval holds.
If a SW-COMPONENT communicates via a PORT-PROTOTYPE that belongs to a PARTIAL-NETWORK, it shall check the status of that PARTIAL-NETWORK before communication.
Each CONSISTENCY-NEEDS is defined either in an ATOMIC-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE or in a COMPOSITION-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE (or both).
If an APPLICATION-DATA-TYPE isVSADT, then there exists a companion IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE and a DATA-TYPE-MAP that refers to both.
如果一个 APPLICATION-RECORD-DATA-TYPE 与一个 APPLICATION-ARRAY-DATA-TYPE 被视为兼容，则必须存在一个 PortInterfaceMapping 详细说明兼容性条款：compatible_Record_Array(r,a) => has_PortInterfaceMappingForPair(r,a)。
运行时行为约束：应用负责保持“有效元素数量”和 Size Indicator 一致，不在静态结构/SMT 模板中强制。
说明性约束：ApplicationCompositeDataType 不能整体赋予特定语义，但可以对其包含的 ApplicationPrimitiveDataTypes 赋予语义。
互斥/优先级约束：如果 has_valueAxisDataTypeRef(SUBJECT) 为真，则 has_compuMethodRef、has_unitRef、has_baseTypeRef 均应为假。
兼容性不要求 shortName 相同：不能把 shortName 相等作为 ApplicationPrimitiveDataType 兼容性的必要条件。
TYPE-TREF 的 DEST 已限制为 AUTOSAR 数据类型集合，因此 PerInstanceMemory 不直接支持 C++ 特定类型或指针类型。
唯一性约束：对于同一 ATOMIC-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE，两个不同的 RUNNABLE-ENTITY 不应具有相同的 SYMBOL。形式化为：ownsRunnable(c,r1) ∧ ownsRunnable(c,r2) ∧ r1≠r2 => symbol(r1)≠symbol(r2)。
SwDataDefProps determines an axis description; no concrete structural condition is enforced.
For each SW-AXIS-INDIVIDUAL, axisValuesTypeDetermined(x) is equivalent to inputTypeSet(x).
For all explicit/implicit inter-runnable variables and perInstance/shared/constant parameters, the latest binding time is preCompileTime.
For COMPU-METHOD with category BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE on sender side, every sender value in its domain must have a mapping to a receiver value.
It is possible (but not required) to define access to calibration parameters at the InstantiationDataDefProps level.
The consistency of SwRecordLayoutV.category and SwRecordLayoutGroup.category with the structure of SwRecordLayout is the author's responsibility; no automatic check is enforced.
Each predefined and free chapter follows the atpVariation stereotype; if a chapter uses atpVariation, its variation point has post-build as latest binding time.

logical_pattern.description: 互斥约束：not (hasSynchronousInvocation(op) and hasAsynchronousInvocation(op))
说明性约束：客户端需要调用特定操作以保证服务器正确工作（静态正确性动机），不形成可验证的结构约束。
通信规范（ComSpec）是可选的：不对任何元素强制存在 ComSpec。

logical_pattern.description: 特定 ComSpec 子类只能被与之对应类型的 PortInterface 所拥有，例如 Client/Server ComSpec 只能出现在 ClientServerInterface 上。
ComSpec 的使用不应被限制在 AtomicSwComponentType 的 PortPrototypes；这是对建模范围的非限制性声明，不形成约束。
能力性约束：CompositionSwComponentType 可以（但不必须）通过 dataTypeMapping 和 constantValueMapping 角色引用 DATA-TYPE-MAPPING-SET 与 CONSTANT-SPECIFICATION-MAPPING-SET。
CompositionSwComponentType 不改变与 VFB 的交互，也不增加聚合组件之外的新功能；这是体系结构层面的语义说明，不形成可判定的结构约束。
说明性约束：PortPrototypes 可以拥有 ComSpecs，但不是必须或禁止；不生成硬性验证规则。
放宽约束：组合层 ComSpecs 不需要与内部 AtomicSwComponentTypes 的 ComSpecs 匹配；不生成结构或逻辑约束。
命名建议：自定义 CATEGORY 值应避免与未来标准值冲突，可通过公司前缀/后缀实现；缺乏标准值全集，无法自动验证。
一般规则：自定义 profile/category 值建议使用公司前缀；纯推荐性，不生成自动验证规则。
当 usesCyclicWriting(NV-BLOCK-DESCRIPTOR) 为真时：必须存在 NV-BLOCK-NEEDS，且其 STORE-CYCLIC 存在并为 true，CYCLIC-WRITING-PERIOD 必须存在。
运行时行为说明：若存在 TIMING-EVENT-REF，则应以 TimingEvent.period 为准而忽略 NvBlockNeeds.cyclicWritingPeriod；不作为结构一致性检查。
流程性要求：相关 DTC 应在 ECUC 中配置，而非在 AtomicSwComponentType 设计时决定；缺乏可观测结构模式，不生成自动验证规则。
语义性说明：如果需求方元素未定义任何 DataConstr，则兼容性检查总是通过；不通过结构或 SMT 强制验证。
行为性/RTE 配置约束：SenderReceiverInterface 中使用 ApplicationDataType 的 dataElement 需要有 ImplementationDataType 映射；当前不在模板中形式化。
流程性约束：DATA-ID 的值由中央机构分配，而非组件开发者；不通过静态模型验证。
行为性/部署一致性约束：dataId 信息在发送端和接收端都必须可用；需要跨文件和运行时配置信息，当前不在 SMT 中形式化。
模式依赖约束：对于 VFB 上 n:1 通信模式（重叠子集合并），DelegatedPortAnnotation.signalFan 必须为 'nfold'；通信模式本身无法从局部 XML 直接观测，暂不形式化。
模式依赖约束：对于 VFB 上 1:n 通信模式（超集拆分），DelegatedPortAnnotation.signalFan 必须为 'nfold'；通信模式无法直接从 XML 结构推断，暂不形式化。
推荐性约束：对于 VFB 上 1:x (0<=x<=n) 且子集不相交的合并模式，DelegatedPortAnnotation.signalFan 应设置为 'single'；由于通信模式不可直接观测，仅作为文档说明。
For compositions in an n:1 split communication pattern, all associated DELEGATED-PORT-ANNOTATION elements shall have SIGNAL-FAN = single.
For each SW-CONNECTOR, every DATA-ELEMENT required by the source R-PORT-PROTOTYPE must be provided by the destination P-PORT-PROTOTYPE.
Recommendation: if a PARAMETER-DATA-PROTOTYPE is modeled as dependent, it should not be directly adjustable.
If a parameter is dependent on another parameter and has a SW-DATA-DEPENDENCY with SW-DATA-DEPENDENCY-FORMULA, then the formula relates the values of base and dependent parameters.
If a dependent parameter is directly influenced, there must exist a base parameter it depends on that is also directly influenced.
DiagEventDebounceAlgorithm inherits Identifiable to allow SDG-based documentation; no hard consistency rule is enforced.
For every CLIENT-SERVER-INTERFACE used in the Dlt Service use case, there must exist a ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT whose ROLE equals the interface's SHORT-NAME.
For each ATOMIC-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE there must exist at least one P-PORT-PROTOTYPE named 'DLTService' and at least one R-PORT-PROTOTYPE named 'LogTraceSessionControl'.
DltUserNeeds is used together with SwcServiceDependency to define configuration requirements for DLT; no direct structural constraint.
For each DO-IP-ACTIVATION-LINE-NEEDS, its owning SWC must have at least one P-PORT-PROTOTYPE.
Practical recommendation about collocation of ECU Abstraction and SensorActuatorSwComponentType; not enforced structurally.
Each NV-BLOCK-DESCRIPTOR has exactly one NV-BLOCK-NEEDS and its STORE-EMERGENCY flag must be true.
ExternalTriggeringPointIdent is a subclass of IdentCaption; handled at the type/ontology level.
ExternalTriggeringPoint may aggregate at most one IDENT (ExternalTriggeringPointIdent).
行为性约束：Failsafe SW-C 在运行时需确保 Warning Indicator Request 位状态正确（例如符合 ISO14229-1 或 OEM 要求）。无法通过静态 ARXML 结构直接验证。
建模说明：在 flat ECU extract 中允许将来自不同 provider 的 dataElement 合并。该约束描述允许的建模方式，而非必须满足的结构约束。
语义说明：保存 functional values 的结构大小由所有轴的轴值数量决定。缺乏明确的 XML 字段与计算公式，暂不生成可执行约束。
建模目的说明：SwAxisGrouped 用于在多个 characteristic table 之间共享轴点。当前缺乏可观测的引用结构与覆盖性条件，暂不生成形式化约束。
关系性说明：Grouped curves 共享相同的 axis 定义。由于缺少具体的 axis 引用字段与分组标识，无法构造静态可检查的约束。
元模型说明：IdentCaption 元类引入 Identifiable 的能力到其子类 ModeAccessPointIdent 和 ExternalTriggeringPointIdent。该约束描述继承/建模结构，不是实例级 ARXML 约束。
元模型继承说明：Identifiable 继承自 Referrable。该信息属于元模型层次，不直接转化为实例级 SHACL/SMT 约束。
若存在 NV-BLOCK-NEEDS，则其 STORE-IMMEDIATE 必须存在且为 true。

实现 variable-size array 的 ImplementationDataTypeElement 聚合链：STRUCTURE(variableSize, allIndicesDifferentArraySize, arraySize defined) 与 ARRAY(无 arraySize/semantics/handling) 成对出现，最后以终止元素结束，其 arraySizeSemantics=variableSize, arraySize 定义，arraySizeHandling=allIndicesSameArraySize。
若 ImplementationDataType.category=TYPE_REFERENCE，则兼容性规则应用于解析后的 resolvedType。
ImplementationDataType 兼容性不要求 shortName 相同。
标准能力声明：AUTOSAR 标准应支持每个 AtomicSwComponentType 的初始化代码执行。
若 DataPrototype 的 CompuMethod.category=SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE，则必须有 INIT-VALUE 指向 ApplicationValueSpecification，且该值规格包含 SW-VALUE-CONT/SW-VALUES-PHYS（抽象为 has_physValues）。
输入值必须从已分配的 VariableDataPrototype 中选择，属于运行时选择约束，通常不在静态 XML 中验证。

Semantic modeling guideline: input values shall be DataPrototype entities originating from specific contexts (VariableDataPrototype in SenderReceiverInterface/NvDataInterface ports, ArgumentDataPrototype in ClientServerInterface operations, or VariableDataPrototype within SwcInternalBehavior). No direct structural check is defined at XML level.
Optional cross-file reference: if INPUT-VARIABLE-TYPE-REF is present in a SW-AXIS-INDIVIDUAL, it shall resolve to an APPLICATION-PRIMITIVE-DATA-TYPE.
Interfaces between ECU Abstraction and SensorActuatorSwComponentType shall be compatible as defined in the specification (chapter 6). No concrete XML-level structural pattern is provided here.

Behavioral constraint: when an interpolation routine is called in a RunnableEntity implementation, an input value must be provided to locate the appropriate axis entry. This is runtime behavior and not directly checkable from static XML structure.
Behavioral constraint: for CURVE, MAP, etc., iteration shall be performed along the input axis. This describes algorithmic behavior rather than static XML structure.

The interface between the Microcontroller Abstraction (MCAL) and the ECU Abstraction is standardized and not visible on the Virtual Function Bus; therefore MCAL and ECU Abstraction must be present on the same ECU. This requires deployment and system-level information and is not encoded as a local XML structural constraint.

In an AUTOSAR implementation only the Microcontroller Abstraction (MCAL) has direct access to peripheral hardware; all hardware access should go through this layer. This is an architectural/behavioral rule, not directly checkable from static XML structure.

For COMPOSITION-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE with DelegatedPortAnnotation.signalFan = 'nfold', every data element of the outer delegation PPort must be provided by at least one inner PPortPrototype of some SwComponentPrototype.

For COMPOSITION-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE with DelegatedPortAnnotation.signalFan = 'single', every data element of the outer delegation PPort must be provided by exactly one inner PPortPrototype of some SwComponentPrototype.
ModeAccessPointIdent is modeled as a subclass of IdentCaption via the asIdentCaption function and isModeAccessPointIdent marker predicate.
ModeAccessPoint optionally aggregates at most one ModeAccessPointIdent in role 'ident'. Cardinality 0..1 is enforced structurally; SMT only models the role.
If a mode user ModeDeclaration is mapped to several mode manager ModeDeclarations via several ModeDeclarationMappings, then for each such mapping transitionsRecognizableToUser holds.
If a single ModeDeclarationMapping maps a mode user to several mode manager ModeDeclarations via multiple FIRST-MODE-REFs, then transitionsRecognizableToUser is false for that mapping.

If an ATOMIC-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE has an internal behavior with PerInstanceMemory and NvBlockNeeds linked via RoleBasedDataAssignment, then nvDataEncapsulatedInSwc holds. PerInstanceMemory is typed either with AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPE or C-DATA-TYPE, but not both.
架构性说明：AtomicSwComponentType 可以通过 PortPrototypes 访问由 NvBlockSwComponentType 提供的 nv data；这些 nv data 可以被打包到更大的 NVRAM Block 中或在多个组件间共享，且由 AutosarDataTypes 进行类型化。未形成可观测的布尔约束。
语义说明：NvBlockNeeds 仅包含软件组件所需的属性；空属性表示“don't care”。当将具有不同 writingFrequency 的 nv data 映射到同一 NVRAM Block 时，NvBlockDescriptor 的 NvBlockNeeds 必须指示最坏情况（更高写入频率）。当前版本不在 SMT 中形式化该聚合逻辑。
说明性约束：NvBlockSwComponentType 可以（可选）拥有 client/server PortPrototypes，用于提供块相关服务、管理服务或通知。未对存在性或数量施加强制约束。
语义说明：对于连接到某 PortPrototype 的 nv data，仅 NvRequireComSpec 上定义的 initValue 具有语义意义；VariableDataPrototype 上的 initValue 被忽略。该约束影响运行时初始化语义，而非静态模型一致性。
运行时行为要求：NvM 对来自 Complex Driver 的紧急写操作应给予最高优先级（重排 NvM 写块请求队列）。不在静态结构或 SMT 模板中强制。
说明：ObdPidServiceNeeds 和 ObdRatioServiceNeeds 是用于描述 OBD 诊断服务调用需求的必要建模元素。但当前约束未给出明确触发条件（例如特定组件或端口存在时必须建模），因此不生成强制存在性公理。
语义：对于每一个与 AtomicSwComponentType 概念上连接的诊断事件，都需要提供一个指向服务组件的 PPortPrototype（1:1 关系）。由于缺少诊断事件及其连接关系的结构化建模信息，当前版本不在 SMT 中形式化该 ∀/∃ 约束。
定义性说明：PRPortPrototype 能够对同一数据进行读写。未形成可执行结构或逻辑约束。
if-present-then-type：若存在 INPUT-VARIABLE-TYPE-REF，则其 DEST 为 APPLICATION-PRIMITIVE-DATA-TYPE。输入值与该类型兼容的语义暂不在 SMT 中建模。
行为性说明：constantMemory 角色的 ParameterDataPrototype 不由 RTE 提供，因此不需要 ParameterAccess 控制 RTE API 生成。未形成可执行逻辑约束。
能力性说明：ParameterSwComponentType 可以（0..*）聚合 InstantiationDataDefProps，不强制存在。
结构上：PER-INSTANCE-MEMORY 必须有且仅有一个 TYPE-DEFINITION（字符串）。语义上：该字符串应可直接包含在 C 头文件中，具体 C 语法检查不在当前 SMT 模板中实现。
行为性说明：可通过 SwcServiceDependency.assignedData 配置多个 NVRAM Block 使用同一 Permanent RAM Block。未形成具体计数或互斥约束。
语义：PortDefinedArgumentValues 不得与 RPortPrototypes 一起使用。需要跨元素关系（所属端口类型），当前缺少明确 XML 路径映射，因此暂不在 SMT 中建模。

If a PORT-GROUP is used for partial networking, then its CATEGORY shall be "PARTIAL_NETWORKING". Trigger (used for partial networking) is not directly observable in XML; SHACL enforces the allowed value when CATEGORY is present.
PortGroups and ServiceProxySwComponentType have a semantical relationship to mode management, but this is not expressed via explicit meta-model relations. No executable constraint.

For each sensor and actuator there is one AUTOSAR PortPrototype at the ECU Abstraction. Requires additional modeling of sensors/actuators and their mapping to PortPrototypes; not enforced as a hard SMT axiom in this template.
RPT access points shall be represented by meta-classes derived from Referrable. This is a meta-model design rule, not an instance-level constraint.

A SYSTEM that describes an RPT system shall have CATEGORY = "RPT_SYSTEM". The fact that a SYSTEM is used to describe an RPT system is not directly observable; SHACL enforces the allowed value when CATEGORY is present.
Values of V within a rational formula are allowed to be floating point; this is a type-level allowance, not a restriction. No additional SMT constraint.
NV-BLOCK-DESCRIPTOR shall have a RAM-BLOCK (structural, enforced by SHACL). It is recommended (but not mandatory) to define a ROM-BLOCK with suitable initial values for the RAM-BLOCK.
若 SenderReceiverAnnotation 的 LIMIT-KIND 为 Min/Max，则其注解的 COMPU-METHOD 至少具有相应的 min/max 属性。
覆盖性约束：对于每个 PortPrototype 的每个 VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE，都存在至少一个 SenderReceiverAnnotation 关联到该 dataElement。
推荐性约束：若某 SensorActuatorSwComponentType 部署在 ECU 上，则该 ECU 上应存在相应的 ECU 抽象层。
每当一个 SENSOR-ACTUATOR 连接到某 ECU 时，其对应的 SENSOR-ACTUATOR-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE 必须处于可用状态。
每个软件组件类型 SW-COMPONENT-TYPE 至少指定一个 ServiceNeeds；BSW 模块类似。
对于每个 SERVICE-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE，存在一个 P-PORT-PROTOTYPE，其 PROVIDED-INTERFACE-TREF 解析到 SHORT-NAME 为 "DoIPActivationLineStatus" 的 MODE-SWITCH-INTERFACE。
对于每个 SERVICE-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE，存在一个 P-PORT-PROTOTYPE，其 PROVIDED-INTERFACE-TREF 解析到 SHORT-NAME 为 "EventStatus" 的 CLIENT-SERVER-INTERFACE。
If an NV-BLOCK-DESCRIPTOR has nvBlockNeeds, then nvBlockNeeds.storeAtShutdown must exist and be true.
For each ClientServerInterface used in StbM Service use cases (is_StbM_Service_Interface), there exists a RoleBasedPortAssignment whose role string matches the interface name.
If an AtomicSwComponentType uses the StbM_TimeBaseValue use case, it must have at least one Client Port.
For AtomicSwComponentTypes using the StbM_TimeBaseValue service, all RoleBasedPortAssignments on their ports must have role = StbM_TimeBaseValue.
For StbM notification use case, an AtomicSwComponentType must have at least one RoleBasedPortAssignment with role StbM_TimeBase_TriggerCustomer or StbM_TimeBase_StateNotification.
For StbM notification use case, an AtomicSwComponentType must provide at least one Receiver Port of type StbM_TimeBase_TriggerCustomer and/or StbM_TimeBase_StateNotification.
For StbM notification use case, valid roles on RoleBasedPortAssignment are StbM_TimeBase_TriggerCustomer [0..1] and StbM_TimeBase_StateNotification [0..1] per AtomicSwComponentType.
If isMultiAxisCompoundPrimitiveAxisCont(SUBJECT) then has_swArraySize_RuleBasedAxisCont(SUBJECT).
If isMultiAxisCompoundPrimitiveValueCont(SUBJECT) then has_swArraySize_RuleBasedValueCont(SUBJECT).
If isMultiAxisCompoundPrimitiveSwAxisCont(SUBJECT) then has_swArraySize_SwAxisCont(SUBJECT).
If isMultiAxisCompoundPrimitiveSwValueCont(SUBJECT) then has_swArraySize_SwValueCont(SUBJECT).
Each SwCalprmRefProxy is aggregated by some SwAxisGrouped: ∀p ∃g. aggregates_SwCalprmRefProxy(g,p).
SwAxisGrouped.swAxisIndex indicates which axis of the shared SwCalprmRef is used; no hard logical constraint modeled.
Each SwAxisIndividual aggregates at least one SwVariableRefProxy: ∀a ∃v. aggregates_SwVariableRefProxy(a,v).
Each SwAxisIndividual must reference value models for min and max axis points: has_swMaxAxisPoints(SUBJECT) ∧ has_swMinAxisPoints(SUBJECT).
Two SwBaseTypes are compatible if a simple conversion exists in at least one direction or they are equal: compatible(t1,t2) = simpleConvertible(t1,t2) ∨ simpleConvertible(t2,t1) ∨ t1=t2.
SwCalprmRefProxy aggregates an AUTOSAR-PARAMETER-REF that associates to a ParameterDataPrototype representing a curve with an axis. No executable structural or logical constraint derived.
Structural definition: SW-COMPONENT-DOCUMENTATION may contain at most one SW-FEATURE-DEF and at most one SW-FEATURE-DESC, plus an arbitrary number of CHAPTER elements.
SW-COMPONENT-DOCUMENTATION is atpSplitable from the component; this is a file organization/tooling feature, not an intra-file structural constraint.

Compatibility guideline: when ImplementationDataType 'adds' properties (note, displayFormat, swImplPolicy), it may not change properties defined by ApplicationDataType; computation methods shall be defined in only one of the types. No generic executable SMT constraint derived due to missing observable criteria for 'add' vs 'change'.

When only the ImplementationDataType may define baseType, its BASE-TYPE-REF shall fit the semantic requirements given by the ApplicationDataType. A project-specific predicate (e.g., baseTypeCompatible) is needed to make this executable.
Redefinition of swAddrMethod or dataConstr by ImplementationDataType is not considered relevant for general compatibility; project-specific rules may restrict which redefinitions are allowed.

Cases where ImplementationDataType is not allowed to set a property but only inherits it from ApplicationDataType are not relevant for compatibility; such attributes are simply not allowed in ImplementationDataType. No generic executable constraint derived because the affected attribute set is not specified here.
If an ApplicationValueSpecification uses a CompuMethod and the application does not yield a valid number, comparison with a NumericalValueSpecification is not possible.
Structural properties of SwDataDefProps shall not be redefined on DataPrototype; only policy aspects may change.
An SwcInternalBehavior may have several DiagnosticEventManagerNeeds elements; no additional cardinality restriction beyond 0..*.
An SwcInternalBehavior may provide several FunctionInhibitionNeeds elements; default 0..* cardinality.
For each RunnableEntity under an SwcInternalBehavior, a list of input values should be specified.
SwcInternalBehavior may provide several SwcServiceDependencys that in turn aggregate NvBlockNeeds elements.
It is explicitly permitted that a SwcServiceDependency with DiagnosticValueNeeds assigns data from a PPortPrototype typed by a SenderReceiverInterface with isService=false.
建模接口：needsDtcStatusNotification(a,k) 可由实例工具推导；dtcStatusKind(d,k) 表示某 SwcServiceDependency 针对的 DTC 状态变化种类。未强制每种 k 都存在对应依赖。
当 usesNvBlockNeeds(d,n) 且 assignedPort(d,r) 时，必须 roleIsNvDataPort(r)。
文档性：SyncTimeBaseMgrUserNeeds 与 SwcServiceDependency 一起用于配置 StbM。
推荐性：implementsDemDebouncingScenario(a,n) 时，diagEventDebounceAlgorithm(n,alg) 应满足 isCounterBased(alg,cb) 或 isTimeBased(alg,tb)。
推荐性：implementsSwcDebouncingScenario(a,n) 时，diagEventDebounceAlgorithm(n,alg) 应满足 isMonitorInternal(alg,mi)。
推荐性：NvBlockDescriptor.timingEvent.period 应等于映射 nv data PortPrototypes 的 NvBlockNeeds.cyclicWritingPeriod 的最小值。
允许性说明：顶层 CompositionSwComponentType 可以包含未连接的 PortPrototypes 以便复用。
For any END-TO-END-TRANSFORMATION-COM-SPEC-PROPS p and associated TRANSFORMATION-TECHNOLOGY t (usesTransformationTechnology p t), protocolValue t must be "EndToEnd".

Rationale only: in a given trigger compatibility context, the client shall call a certain operation so that the server works correctly. Modeled as predicate clientCallsRequiredOperation without hard assertion.

For an APPLICATION-COMPOSITE-ELEMENT-IN-PORT-INTERFACE-INSTANCE-REF r, all contextDataPrototype and targetDataPrototype must be reachable from rootDataPrototype via reachableViaTypePrototypeChain; context prototypes form a nesting chain enclosing the target.
Recommended (not mandatory) that UNIT-GROUP/CATEGORY is one of COUNTRY, CALCULATION, EQUIV_UNITS; additional values may be agreed between stakeholders.

If a UNIT is marked as dimensionless (isDimensionlessUnit), then for its referenced PHYSICAL-DIMENSION all SI exponents (length, mass, time, current, temperature, molar amount, luminous intensity) must be 0.
Compatibility of two UNIT instances does not require equality of their SHORT-NAME values; predicate compatibleUnits is independent of shortName equality.
VariationPointProxy attribute usage is conditional on binding time and category; this entry introduces predicates for later detailed multiplicity/condition rules.

Static and constant memory shall be used to support measurement and calibration. SMT models this as recommendations: usedForMeasurementOrCalibration(p) => hasConstantMemory(ib,p); usedForMeasurementOrCalibrationVar(v) => hasStaticMemory(ib,v).
The order of RuleArguments corresponds to the order of elements in the array. SMT ensures that each index carries at most one of V/VF/VT/VTF, preserving a well-defined ordered argument list.
Only ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category STRING may define an invalidValue. SMT: dataDefPropsOf(adt,p) ∧ hasInvalidValue(p) => categoryOf(adt) = "STRING".
For each compatible implementation data type, if both sides specify invalidValue, they shall be equal.

If category_of(APPLICATION-PRIMITIVE-DATA-TYPE) = STRING then it shall reference swDataDefProps.swTextProps.baseType and the referenced SwBaseType shall have a BaseTypeDirectDefinition.baseTypeEncoding (typically NONE).
Each APPLICATION-ERROR must belong to at least one CLIENT-SERVER-INTERFACE.
If factorSiToUnit/offsetSiToUnit are not explicitly present, they are assumed to be 1 and 0 respectively.
If RULE-ARGUMENTS has a target array size, the total number of arguments (V, VF, VT, VTF) shall not exceed that size.
For RULE-BASED-VALUE-SPECIFICATION with rule = FILL_UNTIL_END, there must be at least one argument; the last argument is conceptually applied to all remaining array elements.
RULE must be either "FILL_UNTIL_END" or "FILL_UNTIL_MAX_SIZE" for every RULE-BASED-VALUE-SPECIFICATION.

Describes general precedence between SwDataDefProps attributes, valueAxisDataType, compuMethod and swCalprmAxisSet; effective interpretation is modeled via helper predicates (e.g., effectiveUnit_Axis) rather than hard structural exclusion.
SwAxisIndividual.inputVariableType wins over SwAxisIndividual.compuMethod and unit for interpretation, but not over dataConstr; captured via effectiveUnit_Axis and effectiveCompuMethod_Axis.

Defines effectiveUnit_ValueAxis precedence: valueAxisDataType.swDataDefProps.unit, then valueAxisDataType.swDataDefProps.compuMethod.unit, then SwDataDefProps.unit, then SwDataDefProps.compuMethod.unit.
effectiveDataConstr_ValueAxis is taken from SwDataDefProps.dataConstr if present, otherwise from SwDataDefProps.valueAxisDataType.swDataDefProps.dataConstr.
effectiveCompuMethod_ValueAxis is taken from SwDataDefProps.valueAxisDataType.swDataDefProps.compuMethod if present, otherwise from SwDataDefProps.compuMethod.

effectiveDisplayFormat_ValueAxis precedence: SwDataDefProps.displayFormat, then valueAxisDataType.swDataDefProps.displayFormat, then valueAxisDataType.swDataDefProps.compuMethod.displayFormat, then SwDataDefProps.compuMethod.displayFormat.
effectiveSwCalibrationAccess_ValueAxis is taken from SwDataDefProps.swCalibrationAccess if present, otherwise from SwDataDefProps.valueAxisDataType.swDataDefProps.swCalibrationAccess.
Precedence for effectiveUnit(SW-AXIS-INDIVIDUAL): unitRef > compuMethod.unit > inputVariableType.swDataDefProps.unit > swVariableRef.autosarVariable.swDataDefProps.(compuMethod.unit or unit).
Precedence for effectiveDataConstr(SW-AXIS-INDIVIDUAL): dataConstrRef > inputVariableType.swDataDefProps.dataConstr > swVariableRef.type.swDataDefProps.dataConstr.
Precedence of calibration access along structure hierarchies: element-level swCalibrationAccess overrides complex-type-level swCalibrationAccess; otherwise complex-type-level applies.
Precedence for effectiveCalAccess_axis: SwCalprmAxis.swCalibrationAccess overrides SwDataDefProps.swCalibrationAccess; if axis has none, use SwDataDefProps.
End-to-end protection may apply to both local and remote communication links.
Different Pretended Networking configuration options shall be encoded as dedicated ModeDeclarations inside a ModeDeclarationGroup.
If a SwComponentType needs to request a Pretended Networking mode change, it shall provide a PPortPrototype typed by a SenderReceiverInterface.
If a SW-COMPONENT-TYPE needsPretendedNetworkingModeReaction, then there exists an R-PORT-PROTOTYPE owned by it whose REQUIRED-INTERFACE-TREF refers to a MODE-SWITCH-INTERFACE.
If a MODE-SWITCH-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC is owned by a PR-PORT-PROTOTYPE and has ENHANCED-MODE-API defined, then its value is semantically ignored.
For any DELEGATION-SW-CONNECTOR attachedToInnerPRPort, there exists a PPortInCompositionInstanceRef used for that attachment.
PortInterface describes only the static structure of exchanged information; dynamic attributes relevant for communication are attached to PortPrototypes. No structural SMT constraint.
For any ARGUMENT-DATA-PROTOTYPE, if TYPE-TREF exists then it must not refer to a CLIENT-SERVER-OPERATION.
If an initial value is defined at a conceptual level and there exists another level with higherPriority that also defines an initial value, then the lower-priority level's initial value is ignored.

If the SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR of an ATOMIC-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE requiresPeriodicExecution of a RUNNABLE-ENTITY, then there exists a TIMING-EVENT with PERIOD and START-ON-EVENT-REF targeting that RUNNABLE-ENTITY.
若一个 CLIENT-SERVER-OPERATION 有 possibleError 而另一个没有，则二者不兼容：has_possibleError(c1) ∧ ¬has_possibleError(c2) ⇒ ¬compatible(c1,c2)

若 VariableAccess 被 RunnableEntity 作为 readLocalVariable 或 writtenLocalVariable 使用，则其 AutosarVariableRef 必须通过 localVariable 引用 inter-runnable variable： (has_readLocalVariable(r,va) ∨ has_writtenLocalVariable(r,va)) ∧ accessedVariable(va,ref) ⇒ uses_localVariable(ref,v) ∧ is_interRunnableVariable(v)

若 inter-runnable variable 未指定 INIT-VALUE，则在行为被要求 well-defined 的前提下，任何读取之前必须存在某 RunnableEntity 对其写入：is_interRunnableVariable(v) ∧ ¬has_initValue(v) ∧ behaviorWellDefined ⇒ ∀r. readsVariable(r,v) ⇒ ∃w. writesVariable(w,v)
每个 INTERNAL-TRIGGER-OCCURRED-EVENT 至少引用一个 INTERNAL-TRIGGERING-POINT 作为 eventSource；可选引用一个 RUNNABLE-ENTITY 作为 startOnEvent：∀e. ∃p. eventSource(e,p)
IoHwAbstractionServerAnnotation 不得用于 NvDataInterface：annotatedPortInterface(ann,pi) ⇒ ¬is_NvDataInterface(pi)
InitEvent 可以引用一个 RunnableEntity 作为 startOnEvent；该触发在 RTE 完全初始化之后发生（时序语义不在 SMT 中进一步约束）

若 dataIdMode=3 且 category=PROFILE_01 且未指定 DATA-ID-NIBBLE-OFFSET，则逻辑上视为其值为 12：has_dataIdMode(e) ∧ dataIdMode(e)=3 ∧ has_category(e) ∧ category(e)=PROFILE_01 ∧ ¬has_dataIdNibbleOffset(e) ⇒ dataIdNibbleOffset(e)=12
结构性说明：MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP 可以通过 MODE-MANAGER-ERROR-BEHAVIOR 和 MODE-USER-ERROR-BEHAVIOR 定义错误行为。
If errorReactionPolicy is the literal 'defaultMode', then defaultModeRef must be present: (has_errorReactionPolicy ∧ is_defaultModePolicy(errorReactionPolicy)) ⇒ has_defaultModeRef.
语义性说明：如果 modeManagerErrorBehavior 未定义，则在运行时假定 initialMode 成为适用模式；该假定不在静态 SMT 中强制。
语义性说明：如果 modeUserErrorBehavior 未定义，则在运行时假定 initialMode 成为适用模式；该假定不在静态 SMT 中强制。
高层行为性约束：所有连接的 mode users 在模式切换通信出错时的行为需要一致；该一致性依赖运行时行为，不在静态模型中强制。
如果 ServiceNeeds 的 kind 为 DoIpGidSynchronizationNeeds，则相关 RoleBasedPortAssignment 的 ROLE 必须是 CallbackTriggerGIDSynchronization。
如果 ServiceNeeds 的 kind 为 DoIpGidNeeds，则相关 RoleBasedPortAssignment 的 ROLE 必须是 CallbackGetGID。
If a SWC-SERVICE-DEPENDENCY has SERVICE-NEEDS of kind DO-IP-POWER-MODE-STATUS-NEEDS, then the associated ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT shall have role 'CallbackGetPowerMode'.
If SERVICE-NEEDS of kind DO-IP-ROUTING-ACTIVATION-AUTHENTICATION-NEEDS is present (0..1), then the associated ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT shall have role 'RoutingActivation'.
PortInterfaceMapping overrides other compatibility rules under certain referenced constraints; treated as high-level semantic guidance, not enforced structurally.

Naming convention: the prefix of the PortInterface shortName used for routing activation shall be taken from the shortName of the enclosing SwcServiceDependency (approximated as equality of modeled short-names).
A ModeDeclaration of a mode user that is not mapped to a ModeDeclaration of a mode manager is still a valid model; no mandatory mapping constraint is imposed.
If SERVICE-NEEDS of kind DO-IP-ACTIVATION-LINE-NEEDS is present, the associated ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT shall have role 'DoIPActivationLineStatus'.
If SERVICE-NEEDS of kind WARNING-INDICATOR-REQUESTED-BIT-NEEDS is present, the associated ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT shall have role 'EventStatus'.
说明性约束：LOWER-LIMIT 和 UPPER-LIMIT 在语义上表示转换前的限制值，无可观测结构或取值模式可静态验证。
说明性约束：除非 swImplPolicy=queued，否则兼容性不要求所有发送端元素都映射到接收端元素。缺乏可观测的映射结构与兼容性判定规则，暂不生成可执行逻辑。
说明性约束：当软件组件作为 mode manager 时，RoleBasedPortAssignment 的有效角色为 AppModeInterface[1]。缺少可观测的“acts as a mode manager”触发条件与计数模式，暂不生成逻辑公理。
说明性约束：当软件组件作为 mode user 时，RoleBasedPortAssignment 的有效角色为 AppModeInterface[1]。缺少可观测触发条件与结构模式，暂不生成逻辑公理。
说明性约束：当软件组件作为 mode requester 时，RoleBasedPortAssignment 的有效角色为 AppModeRequestInterface[1]。缺少可观测触发条件与结构模式，暂不生成逻辑公理。

跨文件值约束：RoleBasedPortAssignment.role 应等于标准化 AUTOSAR Service Interface 模型中相应 PortInterface 的 shortName，且该 PortInterface 所在 AR-PACKAGE.category=BLUEPRINT，顶层 AR-PACKAGE.shortName=AUTOSAR。需要全局模型与包层次信息，当前模板不引入具体 SMT 公理。
说明性约束：dataWriteAccess 允许（但不强制）定义 DataWriteCompletedEvent，其 EVENT-SOURCE-REF 指向 VARIABLE-ACCESS。由于是“允许”而非“必须”，且未给出 if-then 结构性要求，当前不生成 SMT 公理，仅记录跨文件引用信息。
For every DATA-WRITE-COMPLETED-EVENT e, there must be no WAIT-POINT whose TRIGGER-REF refers to e: forall e. not usedAsTriggerInWaitPoint(e).
Documentation-only: default value of SwDataDefProps.swCalibrationAccess is SwCalibrationAccessEnum.notAccessible; not enforced as a hard constraint.

Data conversion shall be supported for AutosarDataTypes that refer to CompuMethods whose CATEGORY is one of {LINEAR, IDENTICAL, SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE, TEXTTABLE, BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE}. Behavioral/support statement, not a structural consistency constraint.
For composite AutosarDataTypes, data conversion is applied individually to each leaf element. Behavioral/runtime rule, not checked statically.

Specification of enumeration values: ImplementationDataType uses TextValueSpecification; ApplicationPrimitiveDataType uses ApplicationValueSpecification.swValueCont.swValuesPhys.vt or ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification.swValueCont.ruleBasedValues.arguments.vt. Too semantic to encode as a simple structural constraint.
nativeDeclaration should only consist of the symbol of an integral C data type. Free-text / language-level recommendation; not enforced by SMT.

If ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype.swCalibrationAccess is readOnly, a referenced FlatInstanceDescriptor.swDataDefProps may refer to a CompuMethod defining literals for MCD display. Contextual/behavioral guidance, not a strict consistency constraint.
Behavioral default: in the context of NvDataInterface/ParameterInterface, invalidationPolicy is treated as dontInvalidate.

If ApplicationPrimitiveDataType.swDataDefProps.swRecordLayout is present, then a corresponding DataTypeMap must exist: has_swDataDefProps & has_swDataDefPropsContent & has_swRecordLayoutRef => has_dataTypeMapFor.

If a ModeSwitchInterface is used by an Application Mode Manager that interacts with both BswM and other ApplicationSwComponentTypes, then isService must be false: isModeManagerForBswMAndApps => not isService.
For all PRPortPrototype instances, isConsideredUnconnected must be false.
If PerInstanceMemory.typeDefinition is present, it must not denote a function pointer: has_typeDefinition => not containsFunctionPointer(typeDefinition).
If DiagnosticCommunicationManagerNeeds.serviceRequestCallbackType is present, it shall equal requestCallbackTypeManufacturer.
For each AtomicSwComponentType and its DiagnosticCommunicationManagerNeeds, serviceRequestCallbackType shall be requestCallbackTypeSupplier.
SenderReceiverInterface used by Dcm ports may set isService to FALSE; this is an exception to constr_2019.
Dem ServiceSwComponentType may have RPortPrototypes whose required interface is a SenderReceiverInterface with isService possibly FALSE.
For any mode receiver, there is at most one mode sender (n:1 is invalid).
If sender-side DataPrototype in a TextTableMapping refers to a CompuMethod of category BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE, completeness of the mapping is not required.

If NvBlockNeeds defines any writing strategy flag, the InternalBehavior of the NvBlockSwComponentType shall contain TimingEvents, DataReceivedEvents, SwcModeSwitchEvents or Runnables to implement the strategy.
For any NvBlockDescriptor, the effective cyclic writing frequency is given by timingEvent.period; nvBlockNeeds.cyclicWritingPeriod is ignored.
If NvBlockNeeds.storeCyclic is true for a descriptor, then a TimingEvent must exist that triggers a RunnableEntity responsible for cyclic nv data writing.
If NvBlockNeeds.storeImmediate is true for a descriptor, then a DataReceivedEvent must exist that activates a RunnableEntity responsible for immediate nv data writing.
The storeEmergency flag requires implementation by a Complex Driver; no structural consistency rule is enforced at model level.
Combinations of nv data writing strategies (cyclic, immediate, emergency, at shutdown) are allowed; no mutual exclusion is enforced.
In the context of SwcServiceDependency, DiagnosticEventNeeds.reportBehavior, if present, shall be ignored; its semantic effect is disabled.
If two RunnableEntitys belonging to different instances of the same AtomicSwComponentType communicate, this communication must be realized via PortPrototypes.
If a TRANSFORMATION-TECHNOLOGY uses more than one USER-DEFINED-TRANSFORMER, each USER-DEFINED-TRANSFORMATION-COM-SPEC-PROPS must be assigned to exactly one transformer used in that chain.
If a SW-C writes a variable-size array of this IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE and changes the number of valid elements, then hasSizeIndicator(idt) must hold.
If a SW-C receives a variable-size array of this IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE, it shall use the Size Indicator to determine the number of valid elements.
Each APPLICATION-ARRAY-DATA-TYPE must have dynamicArraySizeProfile set.
Each APPLICATION-ARRAY-ELEMENT must have arraySizeHandling set.
dynamicArraySizeProfile(SUBJECT) must be one of: VSA_LINEAR, VSA_SQUARE, VSA_RECTANGULAR, VSA_FULLY_FLEXIBLE.
Custom dynamicArraySizeProfile values shall have a company-specific prefix; concrete prefix policy is project-specific.

For RULE-BASED-VALUE-SPECIFICATION with rule = 'FILL_UNTIL_MAX_SIZE', if numArguments < arrayLength and numArguments < maxSizeToFill, then the last argument value is applied to all elements up to maxSizeToFill.
Naming convention: if a custom dynamicArraySizeProfile is used, it shall have a company-specific prefix (captured by predicate usesCompanySpecificPrefix in SMT template).
If representsVariableSizeArray(SUBJECT) then CATEGORY = STRUCTURE and at least two subElements (cardinality partly enforced by SHACL, semantics by SMT).

If mappedToApplicationArray(SUBJECT, a) and dynamicArraySizeProfile_App(a) in {VSA_LINEAR, VSA_SQUARE, VSA_FULLY_FLEXIBLE} and isFirstSubElement(SUBJECT, e) then e is integer and arraySize_Elem(e) >= maxArraySize(a).

For VSA_RECTANGULAR: first subElement e of ImplementationDataType mapped to ApplicationArrayDataType a and corresponding ApplicationArrayElement ae must satisfy CATEGORY(e)=ARRAY and arraySize_Elem(e)=maxNumberOfElements_AppElem(ae).
Elements of the Size Indicator array (isSizeIndicatorArrayElement) must be integers and valueOfElement(elem) >= maxArraySize(a) for the mapped ApplicationArrayDataType a.
If mappedToApplicationArray(t, a) and dynamicArraySizeProfile_App(a) exists, then the second subElement payload of t must have CATEGORY=ARRAY and arraySize_Elem(payload)=maxArraySize(a).
If a hardError occurs on a TRANSFORMER-CHAIN executedFor a RUNNABLE-ENTITY, then canBeStarted is false for that runnable.

If a SW-COMPONENT-TYPE owns a DATA-PROTOTYPE-GROUP in role dpgRequiresCoherence and has RUNNABLE-ENTITY-GROUPs in role regDoesNotRequireStability, then runnables in those groups read intermediaryValues and not coherentValues.
For all PORT-API-OPTION p and RUNNABLE-ENTITY r: if errorHandling(p) = transformerErrorHandling and r accesses portRef(p), then r handlesExtendedTransformerError.
For Security Access PORT-INTERFACE pi and applicable SWC-SERVICE-DEPENDENCY dep: securityAccessSuffix(pi) = shortName_SWC-SERVICE-DEPENDENCY(dep).

For Data Services PORT-INTERFACE pi and applicable SWC-SERVICE-DEPENDENCY dep: dataServicesSuffix(pi) = shortName_SWC-SERVICE-DEPENDENCY(dep). This documents TPS_SWCT_01628, TPS_SWCT_01629, TPS_SWCT_01630.
If a PORT-INTERFACE is an InfotypeServices PortInterface, its shortName must be 'InfotypeServices_' concatenated with the shortName of the applicable SwcServiceDependency.
If a PORT-INTERFACE is a RoutineServices PortInterface, its shortName must be 'RoutineServices_' concatenated with the shortName of the applicable SwcServiceDependency.
If a PORT-INTERFACE is a RequestControlServices PortInterface, its shortName must be 'RequestControlServices_' concatenated with the shortName of the applicable SwcServiceDependency.
If a PORT-INTERFACE is a DataServices PortInterface, its shortName must be 'DataServices_' concatenated with the shortName of the applicable SwcServiceDependency.
Naming conventions (SHORT-NAME-PATTERN) may support the effectiveness of SymbolProps; this is a non-mandatory, model-level recommendation.
If a VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE has an INIT-VALUE, it shall be used as an explicit or implicit inter-runnable variable.
When two PR-PORT-PROTOTYPEs are connected via AssemblySwConnector or PassThroughSwConnector, the connection is undirected: connectsPRPorts_* is symmetric and hasDirection_* is false.
If an AtomicSwComponentType uses DiagnosticValueNeeds, it shall have a RoleBasedPortAssignment with role DataServices_DIDRange.
The suffix of the DataServices_DIDRange PortInterface name is derived from the shortName of the applicable SwcServiceDependency (naming rule, not enforced by SMT).
If INVALIDATION-POLICY.HANDLE-INVALID exists, it shall be equal to HandleInvalidEnum.dontInvalidate.
If dynamicArraySizeProfile is VSA_LINEAR, VSA_SQUARE, or VSA_FULLY_FLEXIBLE, the first subElement is a size indicator integer whose value is <= maxArraySize.
If dynamicArraySizeProfile == VSA_RECTANGULAR, the first subElement has CATEGORY == ARRAY and ARRAY-SIZE equal to the corresponding rectangular dimension size.
If dynamicArraySizeProfile exists, ImplementationDataType must have a second subElement with CATEGORY == ARRAY (payload).
A VSA ImplementationDataType consists of two ImplementationDataTypeElements: the first is the VSA Size Indicator, the second is the VSA Payload.
If baseTypeEncoding == "UTF-16" then the string value of the DATA-PROTOTYPE must not start with a BOM (\uFEFF or \uFFFE).
If ServiceNeeds is DiagnosticIoControlNeeds, then the associated RoleBasedPortAssignments must provide IOControlRequest and IOControlResponse roles.
In the TPS_SWCT_01654 scenario, each DiagnosticIoControlNeeds must reference a DiagnosticValueNeeds.

If a PortInterface represents IOControlRequest_Data or IOControlResponse_Data, its shortName must be 'IOControlRequest_' or 'IOControlResponse_' plus the shortName of the applicable SwcServiceDependency.
If a RoleBasedPortAssignment has role 'IOControlRequest', the referenced RPortPrototype.shortName must be 'IOControlRequest_' + SwcServiceDependency.shortName.
If a RoleBasedPortAssignment has role 'IOControlResponse', the referenced PPortPrototype.shortName must be 'IOControlResponse_' + SwcServiceDependency.shortName.

For a given PortPrototype and its NvDataInterface/NvBlockDescriptor, the mapping between VariableDataPrototype and NvBlockDescriptor.ramBlock must follow one of the three specified mapping modes (direct complete, per-leaf, or sub-element mapping).
If swImplPolicy is explicitly present at this SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT, then the default swImplPolicy does not apply (has_swImplPolicy => not usesDefault_swImplPolicy).
Values of SwAxisCont with category CURVE_AXIS, COM_AXIS, RES_AXIS are for display only; no structural constraint is enforced.
If an AtomicSwComponentType has ServiceNeeds of kind DiagnosticValueNeeds, it must have at least one RoleBasedPortAssignment with role DataServices.

If an AtomicSwComponentType uses DiagnosticValueNeeds for signal-based diagnostics, it must have at least one RoleBasedDataAssignment with role signalBasedDiagnostics and none of its SWC-SERVICE-DEPENDENCY elements may use represented port groups.

If an AtomicSwComponentType reads a diagnostic signal, it must offer at least one AbstractProvidedPortPrototype; if it writes a diagnostic signal, it must offer at least one AbstractRequiredPortPrototype.
If an AtomicSwComponentType has ServiceNeeds of kind DiagnosticRoutineNeeds, it must have at least one RoleBasedPortAssignment with role RoutineServices.
If an AtomicSwComponentType has ServiceNeeds of kind DiagnosticIoControlNeeds, it must have at least one RoleBasedPortAssignment with role DataServices.
For each AtomicSwComponentType: ServiceNeeds is of kind ObdRatioServiceNeeds; if a RoleBasedPortAssignment exists, roles IUMPRNumerator and IUMPRDenominator are mutually exclusive (each 0..1).
For each AtomicSwComponentType: ServiceNeeds is of kind ObdPidServiceNeeds and there is exactly one RoleBasedPortAssignment with role DataServices.

For each AbstractProvidedPortPrototype with RoleBasedDataAssignment: the owning AtomicSwComponentType has ServiceNeeds of kind ObdPidServiceNeeds and the data role signalBasedDiagnostics is present (1..2). Each AtomicSwComponentType has at least one provided and one required port for reading/writing.
For each AtomicSwComponentType: ServiceNeeds is of kind ObdInfoServiceNeeds and there is a RoleBasedPortAssignment with role InfotypeServices.
For each AtomicSwComponentType: ServiceNeeds is of kind ObdMonitorServiceNeeds and there is a RoleBasedPortAssignment with role DTRCentralReport.
For each AtomicSwComponentType: ServiceNeeds is of kind ObdControlServiceNeeds and there is a RoleBasedPortAssignment with role RequestControlServices.
For each AtomicSwComponentType: ServiceNeeds is of kind DiagnosticCommunicationManagerNeeds and there is a RoleBasedPortAssignment with role DCMServices.
For ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT used for ROE services, roleValue must be "Dcm_Roe".
For diagnostics communication security needs, ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT must use roleValue = "SecurityAccess".
For diagnostic communication manager needs, ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT must use roleValue = "CallbackDCMRequestServices".
Supervised Entity setup: at least one ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT with roleValue = "WdgM_AliveSupervision"; optionally roleValue = "WdgM_IndividualMode".
Global supervision status setup: ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT must use roleValue = "WdgM_GlobalMode".
Crypto hash usage: ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT must use roles CsmHash and CsmCallback.
Crypto MAC usage: ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT must use roles CsmMacGenerate and CsmCallback.
If a ROLE exists on a ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT for MAC verification, its value must be either CsmMacVerify or CsmCallback.
If a ROLE exists on a ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT for random seed generation, its value must be either CsmRandomSeed or CsmCallback.
If a ROLE exists on a ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT for random number generation, its value must be either CsmRandomGenerate or CsmCallback.
Behavioral description: AtomicSwComponentType uses the symmetrical block encryption of the Crypto Service. No additional structural constraint beyond role lists.
Behavioral description: AtomicSwComponentType uses the symmetrical block decryption of the Crypto Service. No additional structural constraint beyond role lists.
Behavioral description: AtomicSwComponentType uses the symmetrical encryption of the Crypto Service. No additional structural constraint beyond role lists.
Behavioral description: AtomicSwComponentType uses the symmetrical decryption of the Crypto Service. No additional structural constraint beyond role lists.
AtomicSwComponentType uses the asymmetrical encryption of the Crypto Service; valid role-based port assignment role: CsmAsymEncrypt [1] together with CsmCallback [1].
AtomicSwComponentType uses the asymmetrical decryption of the Crypto Service; valid role-based port assignment role: CsmAsymDecrypt [1] together with CsmCallback [1].
AtomicSwComponentType uses the signature generation of the Crypto Service; valid role-based port assignment role: CsmSignatureGenerate [1] together with CsmCallback [1].
AtomicSwComponentType uses the signature verification of the Crypto Service; valid role-based port assignment role: CsmSignatureVerify [1] together with CsmCallback [1].
AtomicSwComponentType uses the checksum calculation of the Crypto Service; valid role-based port assignment role: CsmChecksum [1] together with CsmCallback [1].
AtomicSwComponentType uses the key derivation of the Crypto Service; valid role-based port assignment role: CsmKeyDerive [1] together with CsmCallback [1].
AtomicSwComponentType uses the symmetric key derivation of the Crypto Service; valid role-based port assignment role: CsmKeyDeriveSymKey [1] together with CsmCallback [1].
For AtomicSwComponentType using key exchange interface for public value calculation, RoleBasedPortAssignment must contain exactly one role CsmKeyExchangeCalcPubVal and exactly one role CsmCallback.
For AtomicSwComponentType using key exchange interface for secret value calculation, RoleBasedPortAssignment must contain exactly one role CsmKeyExchangeCalcSecret and exactly one role CsmCallback.
For AtomicSwComponentType using key exchange interface to calculate symmetric key, RoleBasedPortAssignment must contain exactly one role CsmKeyExchangeCalcSymKey and exactly one role CsmCallback.
For AtomicSwComponentType using symmetric key extraction, RoleBasedPortAssignment must contain exactly one role CsmSymKeyExtract and exactly one role CsmCallback.
For AtomicSwComponentType using symmetric key wrapping with symmetric key, RoleBasedPortAssignment must contain exactly one role CsmSymKeyWrapSym and exactly one role CsmCallback.
For AtomicSwComponentType using symmetric key wrapping with asymmetric key, RoleBasedPortAssignment must contain exactly one role CsmSymKeyWrapAsym and exactly one role CsmCallback.
For AtomicSwComponentType using asymmetric public key extraction, RoleBasedPortAssignment must contain exactly one role CsmAsymPublicKeyExtract and exactly one role CsmCallback.
RAPID-PROTOTYPING-SCENARIO shall have at least one BY-PASS-POINT-IREF (checked structurally by SHACL).
If an RPT-HOOK does not use RPT-AR-HOOK-IREF, it shall use CODE-LABEL to describe the rapid prototyping algorithm.

If a SwComponentPrototype is referenced as BY-PASS-POINT-IREF by an RPT-CONTAINER without sub RPT-CONTAINERs, then for every RTE-INTERFACE of that SwComponentPrototype and every RPT-HOOK of the container, rteInterfaceSupportsHook holds.

If a RUNNABLE-ENTITY is referenced as BY-PASS-POINT-IREF by an RPT-CONTAINER without sub RPT-CONTAINERs, then for every RTE-INTERFACE of that RUNNABLE-ENTITY and every RPT-HOOK of the container, rteInterfaceSupportsHook holds.
Permanent RAM Block: at least one RoleBasedDataAssignment with role='ramBlock'; at most one with role='defaultValue'.
Temporary RAM Block: RoleBasedDataAssignment may have at most one instance with role='defaultValue'.
Temporary RAM Block: RoleBasedDataTypeAssignment may have at most one instance with role='temporaryRamBlock'.
For each SwcServiceDependency that uses NvData (usesNvData), there must exist at least one assigned RoleBasedPortAssignment with role='NvDataPort'.

Nvm use case: allowed ROLE values for RoleBasedPortAssignment; NvMMirror mandatory; RoleBasedDataAssignment must reference perInstanceParameter or sharedParameter; RoleBasedDataTypeAssignment must reference IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE.
All RoleBasedPortAssignment ROLE values must be 'FunctionInhibition' and at least one such assignment must exist per AtomicSwComponentType using this scenario.

RoleBasedPortAssignment ROLE must be one of {DLTService, LogTraceSessionControl, VerboseModeControl, InjectionCallback}; at least one DLTService and one LogTraceSessionControl per component using this scenario.
If instantiationRteEventProps is applied for an ApplicationSwComponentType within a CompositionSwComponentType, then instantiationTimingEventProps must be present.
Pattern A* (1:n, RPort:PPort) must not be used: not usesPatternAStar(p) for all PortPrototype p.

Bidirectional existence: has_compuInternalToPhys(x) iff has_compuPhysToInternal(x).

Informational: Within AUTOSAR only the stepwise definition (CompuScales) is used for CompuMethods.

For each DelegationSwConnector c: ports srcPort(c) and dstPort(c) must both be PPort or both be RPort.

No composition may (transitively) contain a SwComponentPrototype typed by itself: not (reaches c c).
If two connected ports are not both typed by DataInterface (or subclasses), their PortInterfaces must be of the same kind.
For any client port, all connected server ports must be identical (no fan-out to multiple servers).
If a ClientServerOperation op is owned by interface i and has a POSSIBLE-ERROR-REF to err, then err must also be owned by i.
For any mapping between two AUTOSAR-DATA-PROTOTYPEs, it is forbidden that one has swImplPolicy queued and the other has a different swImplPolicy.

For each DATA-PROTOTYPE-MAPPING, if sender and receiver data prototypes and their AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPEs are given, then at least one of: compatible types, available data conversion, or defined FIRST-TO-SECOND-DATA-TRANSFORMATION must hold.
For any pair of ARGUMENT-DATA-PROTOTYPEs, either their AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPEs are compatible or a data conversion between them is available.
For each PORT-INTERFACE and its COM-SPECs, only combinations allowed by the AUTOSAR table are valid (captured by allowedPortInterfaceComSpec).
If a DATA-FILTER is applied to a data type, that AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPE must have an integer base type.
For a PORT-INTERFACE, the encoding of its SW-BASE-TYPE (when applicable) must be one of the allowed encodings (2C, IEEE754, ISO-8859-1, ISO-8859-2, WINDOWS-1252, UTF-8, UTF-16, UCS-2, NONE, BOOLEAN).

compatible_ApplicationPrimitive(a1,a2) iff (same category and compatible_SwDataDefProps) or existence of appropriate DataPrototypeMapping / SubElementMapping as per constr_1047.
compatible_ApplicationRecord(r1,r2) iff elements at same record position are compatible or suitable SubElementMappings exist.
compatible_ApplicationArray(a1,a2) iff element types are compatible and maxNumberOfElements/arraySizeSemantics match (if present) or suitable SubElementMappings exist.
compatible_Implementation(i1,i2) iff same category, sameStructure_Impl, compatible_SwDataDefProps, or suitable DataPrototypeMappings/SubElementMappings exist.
compatible_SwDataDefProps(p1,p2) iff units, compuMethods, invalidValue, dataConstr, and swRecordLayout are pairwise compatible or both absent as specified in constr_1051.
compatible_Unit(u1,u2) iff factorSiToUnit and offsetSiToUnit are equal (if present) and physicalDimensionRef is identical or both absent.
compatible_PhysicalDimension(d1,d2) iff all exponent attributes are identical (when present) and either shortName is identical or a PhysicalDimensionMapping exists that maps between d1 and d2.
If provider defines no constraints (not has_providerConstraints) then receiver must also define no constraints (not has_receiverConstraints).
If BASE-TYPE-REF exists under SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT then it refers to a compatible SW-BASE-TYPE; compatibility refined in SMT via additional predicates.
All IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPEs referenced via IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE-REF shall be pairwise compatible (compatibleImplTypes).

SwDataDefProps.swPointerTargetProps shall have identical targetCategory and refer to SwDataDefProps where all attributes are identical; modeled via compatibleDataRefProps(p1,p2) when targetCategory matches.
All BSW-MODULE-ENTRYs referenced by swPointerTargetProps.functionPointerSignature shall resolve to the same function signature (sameFunctionSignature).

For ApplicationDataType with category VALUE and ImplementationDataType with category VALUE, the SwBaseType must cover the range defined by ApplicationDataType.swDataDefProps.dataConstr or by the CompuMethod (coversRange or coversCompuMethodRange).

If mappedTo(a,i) and category_ApplicationDataType(a) = 'STRUCTURE' then category_ImplementationDataType(i) = 'STRUCTURE'.
If mappedTo(a,i) and category_ApplicationDataType(a) = 'BOOLEAN' then category_ImplementationDataType(i) = 'VALUE'.
If mappedTo(a,i) and category_ApplicationDataType(a) in {COM_AXIS, RES_AXIS, CURVE, MAP, CUBOID, CUBE_4, CUBE_5} then category_ImplementationDataType(i) in {STRUCTURE, ARRAY}.
If mappedTo(a,i) then category_ImplementationDataType(i) is not in {UNION, DATA_REFERENCE, FUNCTION_REFERENCE}.
compatibleDataPrototypes(p1,p2) iff (compatibleAutosarDataTypes(typeOf(p1),typeOf(p2)) and same shortName and equal swImplPolicy) or they are related via some DATA-PROTOTYPE-MAPPING.

portsCompatible_Assembly(conn) iff (for each DP in required interface there is a compatible DP in provided interface, or a VariableAndParameterInterfaceMapping.dataMapping exists) and for each such pair the isService flags of the interfaces are equal.
portsCompatible_Delegation(conn) iff ((1a or 1b) and (2a or 2b) and 3) as described in constr_1070, using compatibleDataPrototypes and isService equality.
For any PortPrototype using a ParameterDataPrototype and a VariableDataPrototype and typed by a PortInterface, the combinationAllowedByTable6_1(par,var,pi) must hold.

For each AssemblySwConnector, modeSwitchInterfacesCompatible_Assembly(conn) is equivalent to: (1) either compatibleModeGroupPrototype holds for the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypes of the required/provided ModeSwitchInterfaces or a ModeInterfaceMapping.modeMapping relates them; and (2) isService is equal on both interfaces.

For each DelegationSwConnector, modeSwitchInterfacesCompatible_Delegation(conn) is equivalent to: (1) either compatibleModeGroupPrototype holds for the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypes of the inner/outer ModeSwitchInterfaces or a ModeInterfaceMapping.modeMapping relates them; and (2) isService is equal on both interfaces.
compatibleModeGroupPrototype(p1,p2) is equivalent to: either their referenced ModeDeclarationGroups are compatible or there exists a ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypeMapping that relates p1 and p2.

compatibleModeDeclarationGroup(gReq,gProv) iff either detailed structural and attribute equivalence holds (same number of ModeDeclarations, matching shortNames, initialModes, error behaviors, category and values/onTransitionValue) or a ModeDeclarationMapping relates corresponding ModeDeclarations.
compatibleArgument(a1,a2) iff (their referenced AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPEs are compatible or a ClientServerOperationMapping.argumentMapping relates them) and direction(a1)=direction(a2).
compatibleApplicationError(e1,e2) iff (shortName and errorCode are identical) or a ClientServerInterfaceMapping.errorMapping relates e1 and e2.
CSOperationCompatible(r,p) iff same argCount, pairwise ArgCompatible on ordered arguments, same shortName, and for each possibleError of provided p there exists AppErrorCompatible in required r.

CSInterfaceCompatible_Assembly(req,prov,c): either name-based coverage of operations or mapping-based, and csif_isService(req)=csif_isService(prov); must hold for interfaces connected by AssemblySwConnector.

CSInterfaceCompatible_Delegation(reqInner,reqOuter,c) and analogous for provided side: required side like Assembly (coverage or mapping), provided side requires at least one compatible operation; isService flags equal for inner/outer pairs.
TriggerInterfaceCompatible_Assembly(req,prov,c): for each Trigger in required there is a matching Trigger in provided by shortName or via mapping; isService flags equal.

TriggerInterfaceCompatible_Delegation(reqInner,reqOuter,provInner,provOuter,c): one of (a) coverage on required side, (b) at least one compatible Trigger on provided side, (c) mapping-based; isService equal for inner/outer pairs.
TriggerCompatible(t1,t2) iff trigger_shortName(t1) = trigger_shortName(t2).

CSOperationDelegationOK(iface) is a semantic hook for 'exactly one connection via DelegationSwConnector or PassThroughSwConnector with a compatible ClientServerOperation for each operation of the provided outer PortPrototype'.

portsCompatible(rp,pp) iff there exists at least one compatible VariableDataPrototype or ParameterDataPrototype pair between the interfaces of rp and pp, identified either by equal shortName or by a PortInterfaceMapping.
Functionality constraint: for any two SW-CONNECTORs with same source and target PortPrototypes, the connectors must be identical (uniqueness of connector per port pair).
The two PortPrototypes connected by an AssemblySwConnector must belong to SwComponentPrototypes that are owned by the same CompositionSwComponentType.
A DelegationSwConnector can only connect PortPrototypes of a SwComponentPrototype that is owned by the same CompositionSwComponentType that also owns the connected delegationPortPrototype.
Functional uniqueness: a RunnableEntity can be associated with at most one WaitPoint.
The RTEEvent referenced by TRIGGER-REF of a WaitPoint must be one of: DataReceivedEvent, DataSendCompletedEvent, ModeSwitchedAckEvent, AsynchronousServerCallReturnsEvent.
A ParameterSwComponentType must not aggregate a SwcInternalBehavior and may only own PPortPrototypes whose PortInterface is of type ParameterInterface.
If has_nDataSets(x) and nDataSets(x) > 0 and has_reliability(x) then reliability(x) != errorCorrection.
For any SWC-MODE-SWITCH-EVENT e, if has_startOnEventRef(e) then the referenced RUNNABLE-ENTITY has no WAIT-POINT.
If an RTE-EVENT has DISABLED-MODE-IREF and START-ON-EVENT-REF to a RUNNABLE-ENTITY r, then r must not have a WAIT-POINT.
No MODE-DECLARATION m such that modeRefs(e,m) and disabledModeRefs(e,m) both hold for the same SWC-MODE-SWITCH-EVENT e.
For unconnected R-PORT-PROTOTYPE p typed by DATA-INTERFACE, every NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC reachable via REQUIRED-COM-SPECS must have INIT-VALUE.
If an R-PORT-PROTOTYPE is typed by MODE-SWITCH-INTERFACE, at most one SW-CONNECTOR may reference it as its RPort.
If ENABLE-UPDATE is true for a NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC c, then the referenced dataElement must not be referenced by any VARIABLE-ACCESS in role dataReadAccess.

For any R-PORT-PROTOTYPE typed by a TRIGGER-INTERFACE, there must not be two distinct SW-CONNECTORs referencing it that in turn reference P-PORT-PROTOTYPEs whose TRIGGER-INTERFACEs contain TRIGGERs with the same SHORT-NAME.
If category_IDT(this) = ARRAY and this owns an IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE-ELEMENT e with has_arraySize(e), then arraySize(e) > 0.
If category_IDTE(this) = ARRAY and has_arraySize(this) then arraySize(this) > 0.
If category_IDT(this) = STRUCTURE then there exists e with ownsElement(this, e).
If category_IDTE(this) = STRUCTURE then there exists sub with ownsSubElement(this, sub).
If category_IDT(this) = UNION then there exists e with ownsElement(this, e).
If category_IDTE(this) = UNION then there exists sub with ownsSubElement(this, sub).
0 <= errorCode(this) <= 63 and (errorCode(this) = 0) <=> representsE_OK(this).

If a SW-COMPONENT-PROTOTYPE is typed by a SENSOR-ACTUATOR-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE and usesIOHAL, then it is mapped to exactly one ECU that contains an HW-ELEMENT corresponding to the HW-TYPE referenced by the SENSOR-ACTUATOR-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE.
CATEGORY of END-TO-END-DESCRIPTION must be one of {"NONE", "PROFILE_01", "PROFILE_02"}. This is enforced structurally by SHACL; no additional SMT axiom is required.
For END-TO-END-DESCRIPTION with CATEGORY="PROFILE_01": exactly one DATA-ID exists and its value is in [0,65535].
If CATEGORY="PROFILE_01" and DATA-ID-MODE exists, its value is in [0,3].
For CATEGORY="PROFILE_01", DATA-LENGTH and at least one DATA-ID shall exist.
If CATEGORY="PROFILE_01" and CRC-OFFSET exists, its value is in [0,65535] and divisible by 4.
If CATEGORY="PROFILE_01" and COUNTER-OFFSET exists, its value is in [0,65535] and divisible by 4.
If CATEGORY="PROFILE_01" and DATA-LENGTH exists, its value is in [0,240] and divisible by 8.
In PROFILE_01, MAX-DELTA-COUNTER-INIT on EndToEndDescription, NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC and QUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC, if present, must be in [0,14].
In PROFILE_02, END-TO-END-DESCRIPTION shall only have CATEGORY, DATA-LENGTH and DATA-IDS/DATA-ID as attributes; enforced structurally via SHACL.
If category == PROFILE_02 and DATA-LENGTH is present, then 0 <= dataLength <= 65535 and dataLength mod 8 = 0.
If category == PROFILE_02 then exactly 16 DATA-ID values exist and each is in [0..255].
If category == PROFILE_02 and MAX-DELTA-COUNTER-INIT is present on END-TO-END-DESCRIPTION, its value is in [0..15].
If MAX-DELTA-COUNTER-INIT is present on NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC, its value is in [0..15].
If MAX-DELTA-COUNTER-INIT is present on QUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC, its value is in [0..15].
The DataConstr (limits) of the providing data element shall be within the constraints of the requiring data element. Semantic compatibility not formalized here.
If two or more OperationInvokedEvents reference the same RunnableEntity, all related ServerComSpecs shall have identical queueLength. Detailed cross-structure logic not encoded here.
For a NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC, if a dataElement is referenced and its SW-IMPL-POLICY is present, then swImplPolicy != 'queued'.
For each QUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC, if the referenced VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE has SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT with SW-IMPL-POLICY, then swImplPolicy must be queued.
For each NONQUEUED-SENDER-COM-SPEC, if the referenced VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE has SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT with SW-IMPL-POLICY, then swImplPolicy must not be queued.
For each QUEUED-SENDER-COM-SPEC, if the referenced VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE has SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT with SW-IMPL-POLICY, then swImplPolicy must be queued.
Within a COMPU-METHOD, any two COMPU-SCALEs that share the same SYMBOL and both have LOWER-LIMIT and UPPER-LIMIT must have identical limits.
For COMPU-METHOD of category TEXTTABLE: physConstr is forbidden, compuInternalToPhys must exist, and each COMPU-SCALE must have both LOWER-LIMIT and UPPER-LIMIT.
For COMPU-METHOD of category BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE, each VT in COMPU-CONST-TEXT-CONTENT must not contain the separator character '|'.
If a P-PORT-PROTOTYPE is typed by a PARAMETER-INTERFACE, then its owning component must be a PARAMETER-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE.
Modeling note: assignedPort in combination with a DiagEventDebounceAlgorithm is only meaningful for DIAG-EVENT-DEBOUNCE-MONITOR-INTERNAL.
For any DIAG-EVENT-DEBOUNCE-MONITOR-INTERNAL with an assignedPort, the port must refer to an RPortPrototype and have role 'DiagFaultDetectionCounterPort'.
If handleInvalid = replace and both initValue and invalidValue are present, then initValue must not equal invalidValue.
If a VariableAccess has a SCOPE, then it must belong to one of the roles: dataReadAccess, dataWriteAccess, dataSendPoint, dataReceivePointByValue, dataReceivePointByArgument.
The category of CompuMethod shall not be extended by user-specific values (allowed set defined elsewhere).
The category of AutosarDataType (all concrete subtypes) shall not be extended by user-specific values.
If sensorActuator or hardwareElement references are present, they must resolve to instances of HwType (not other HwDescriptionEntity subclasses).
If a COMPU-SCALE has SYMBOL, then category of its enclosing COMPU-METHOD must be one of SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE, SCALE_RATIONAL_AND_TEXTTABLE, TEXTTABLE, BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE.
MODE_MANAGEMENT and PARTIAL_NETWORKING are reserved CATEGORY values for PORT-GROUP.
For any PORT-INTERFACE used by an NV-BLOCK-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE, IS-SERVICE must be false.
If a PORT-PROTOTYPE is used for NV data management, its PORT-INTERFACE must be compatible to MOD_GeneralBlueprints-derived interfaces.
valueType of PORT-DEFINED-ARGUMENT-VALUE must reference an AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPE whose CATEGORY is VALUE or TYPE_REFERENCE; TYPE_REFERENCE only supported if target data type CATEGORY is VALUE.
A PORT-INTERFACE-MAPPING is applicable for an SW-CONNECTOR only if the two PORT-PROTOTYPEs referenced by the connector are typed by the same two PORT-INTERFACEs mapped by the mapping.
CATEGORY of APPLICATION-ARRAY-ELEMENT must equal CATEGORY of the referenced AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPE.
Enabling predicate for CompuScale compatibility constraints: compatibilityCategoryEnabled(m) iff COMPU-METHOD/CATEGORY is one of the listed values.

For sender-receiver communication, the set of CompuScales of the provider CompuMethod (PPort) shall be a subset of the set of CompuScales of the required CompuMethod (RPort). Requires communication wiring model; not directly mapped to low-level predicates here.

Client-server compatibility: for IN arguments scales(client) ⊆ scales(server); for OUT arguments scales(server) ⊆ scales(client); for INOUT arguments scales(client) = scales(server). Requires explicit operation/argument/direction model.

If hasRunnableEntityArgument(r) then triggeredByClientServerOperation(r).

For both NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC and QUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC, REPLACE-WITH exists iff handleOutOfRange==externalReplacement or the associated SenderReceiverInterface has an InvalidationPolicy with handleInvalid==externalReplacement.
At most one SUB-ELEMENT-MAPPING may exist under a DATA-PROTOTYPE-MAPPING.
Each LIMIT must yield a numerical value after variability binding, modeled as existence of a NumericValue via limitContent.

For each MODE-DECLARATION m: if its group g has at least one MODE-TRANSITION and m is not the initialMode of g, then there exists a MODE-TRANSITION t in g with enteredMode(t)=m.
identicalModeTransitions(g1,g2) iff for every MODE-TRANSITION in g1 there is one in g2 with same identity and same entered/exited ModeDeclaration, and vice versa.

If activation(e) = onTransition and the corresponding ModeDeclarationGroup has at least one MODE-TRANSITION, then there exists a MODE-TRANSITION t with exitedMode(t)=modeRef1(e) and enteredMode(t)=modeRef2(e).
NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC shall not have both NETWORK-REPRESENTATION and COMPOSITE-NETWORK-REPRESENTATION.
QUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC shall not have both NETWORK-REPRESENTATION and COMPOSITE-NETWORK-REPRESENTATION.
NONQUEUED-SENDER-COM-SPEC shall not have both NETWORK-REPRESENTATION and COMPOSITE-NETWORK-REPRESENTATION.
QUEUED-SENDER-COM-SPEC shall not have both NETWORK-REPRESENTATION and COMPOSITE-NETWORK-REPRESENTATION.

If an APPLICATION-COMPOSITE-DATA-TYPE has at least one COMPOSITE-NETWORK-REPRESENTATION, then for each leaf APPLICATION-COMPOSITE-ELEMENT-DATA-PROTOTYPE exactly one COMPOSITE-NETWORK-REPRESENTATION exists for that leaf.
For any VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE owned by a PR-PORT-PROTOTYPE, if SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS exists then swImplPolicy must not be 'queued'.
If a NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC is owned by an R-PORT-PROTOTYPE via REQUIRED-COM-SPECS, then it must have an INIT-VALUE.
AssemblySwConnector endpoints must conform to the connection patterns enumerated in Table 4.4 for SenderReceiverInterface/NvDataInterface.
DelegationSwConnector endpoints must conform to the connection patterns enumerated in Table 4.5 for SenderReceiverInterface/NvDataInterface.

DelegationSwConnector endpoints must conform to the connection patterns enumerated in Table 4.12 for ClientServerInterface, ModeSwitchInterface, or TriggerInterface.
Reject configurations where several user ModeDeclarations map to the same manager ModeDeclaration for the same mode manager and mode user.

In PROFILE_01, if has_e2e_maxNoNewOrRepeatedData then value in [0..14]; in PROFILE_02, if has_e2e_maxNoNewOrRepeatedData then value in [0..15].

For both NONQUEUED and QUEUED ReceiverComSpec, if syncCounterInit is present then it is in [0..14] for PROFILE_01 and [0..15] for PROFILE_02.

If receiver equals requiredComSpec.dataElement and RPortPrototype.requiredComSpec.maxNoNewOrRepeatedData is defined, then profile_maxNoNewOrRepeatedData equals that value. If receiver equals requiredComSpec.dataElement and RPortPrototype.requiredComSpec.maxNoNewOrRepeatedData is defined, then profile_maxNoNewOrRepeatedData equals that value. If usesInvalidation(SUBJECT) then swImplPolicy is present and not equal to 'queued'.
compatibleSwBaseType(a,b) iff baseTypeSize, maxBaseTypeSize, byteOrder, memAlignment, baseTypeEncoding, and nativeDeclaration are pairwise equal.

If DATA-PROTOTYPE is typedBy APPLICATION-PRIMITIVE-DATA-TYPE then its initValue is an ApplicationValueSpecification; if the type is an enumeration, the value must match one of vt/shortLabel/symbol from applicable CompuScales.
If category_autosarDataType(SUBJECT) = STRING and initValue is an ApplicationValueSpecification PROPERTY then category_appValue(PROPERTY) = STRING.
If a DATA-PROTOTYPE is typedBy APPLICATION-RECORD-DATA-TYPE then its initValue is a RecordValueSpecification.
If a DATA-PROTOTYPE is typedBy APPLICATION-ARRAY-DATA-TYPE then its initValue is an ArrayValueSpecification or an ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification.
If dataPrototypeUsesTextTableCompuMethod(SUBJECT) then SUBJECT is a TextValueSpecification and its textValue equals vt, shortLabel or symbol of some associated COMPU-SCALE.
Range restriction: if has_bitPosition(SUBJECT) then 0 <= bitPosition(SUBJECT) <= 31.
For each RunnableEntity, all contained ExecutableEntityActivationReasons have pairwise different bitPosition and pairwise different symbol.
If some WAIT-POINT/TRIGGER-REF resolves to an RTE-EVENT e, then e shall not have an ACTIVATION-REASON-REPRESENTATION-REF to an EXECUTABLE-ENTITY-ACTIVATION-REASON.
If a COMPOSITION-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE aggregates a CONSISTENCY-NEEDS, then all instanceRef associations inside that CONSISTENCY-NEEDS stay within the context of that composition.
If an ATOMIC-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE aggregates a CONSISTENCY-NEEDS, then all instanceRef associations inside that CONSISTENCY-NEEDS stay within the context of that atomic component.
If INSTANTIATION-TIMING-EVENT-PROPS has a REFINED-EVENT-IREF, the referenced RTE-EVENT must be a TIMING-EVENT (isTimingEvent).

For each ClientServerOperationMapping m, firstOperation(m) and secondOperation(m) are distinct and belong to different ClientServerInterfaces: distinct(fo,so) ∧ distinct(interfaceOfOperation(fo), interfaceOfOperation(so)).

For each ClientServerApplicationErrorMapping m, firstApplicationError(m) and secondApplicationError(m) are distinct and belong to different ClientServerInterfaces: distinct(fe,se) ∧ distinct(interfaceOfApplicationError(fe), interfaceOfApplicationError(se)).
For each argument owned by firstOperationOfMapping(m) or secondOperationOfMapping(m), there exists a DATA-PROTOTYPE-MAPPING owned by m that references it in firstDataPrototype or secondDataPrototype.
If category(t) is set and not equal to "STRING", then hasInvalidValue(t) must be false.

If category(t) = "STRING" and hasInvalidValue(t), then invalidValue must be either a compatible ApplicationValueSpecification or a ConstantReference that points to a compatible ApplicationValueSpecification.
Exclusive-or: for each NUMERICAL-OR-TEXT, (has_vf XOR has_vt) and at least one is present.
For any DATA-PROTOTYPE usedInAtomicSwComponent, if it has SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS and SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT with ADDITIONAL-NATIVE-TYPE-QUALIFIER, its value must not equal the literal "enum".
For a provider/user pair of MODE-DECLARATION-GROUPs, either one defines ModeTransitions, or their transitions are compatible / mapped via ModeDeclarationMapping.
