If a MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP-PROTOTYPE-MAPPING has a MODE-DECLARATION-MAPPING-SET-REF, then the owning groups of firstMode and secondMode in that set must match the types of FIRST-MODE-GROUP-REF and SECOND-MODE-GROUP-REF respectively.

IFF-compatibility of PortPrototypes of different DATA-INTERFACEs in a PassThroughSwConnector: at least one compatible pair of VariableDataPrototype/ParameterDataPrototype exists (by shortName or PortInterfaceMapping and matching swImplPolicy), and for each such pair the PortInterface.isService flags are identical.

Compatibility of ModeSwitchInterfaces in a PassThroughSwConnector: for the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype in the required interface a compatible one exists in the provided interface (by shortName or ModeInterfaceMapping), and for each such pair the PortInterface.isService flags are identical.
csInterfaceCompatible(providedInterface, requiredInterface) is defined by operation pairing and equal isService; PassThroughSwConnector compatibility is checked via this predicate.
triggerInterfaceCompatible(requiredTriggerInterface, providedTriggerInterface) is defined by trigger pairing and equal isService.
If connectedViaSwConnector(requiredOuterPort, providedOuterPort) and not hasAtomicSwcOnPath(requiredOuterPort, providedOuterPort) then the PassThroughSwConnector is forbidden.
Allowed multiplicities depend on binding time and category according to Table 7.111; unspecified attributes are interpreted as [0].
For APPLICATION-PRIMITIVE-DATA-TYPE of category BOOLEAN or STRING, any referenced UNIT from SwDataDefProps or PhysConstrs must have all physical exponents equal to 0.

Within one SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR, two different RUNNABLE-ENTITY instances must not both write/send to the same VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE if the corresponding SenderComSpec has transmissionAcknowledge = true.
If INIT-EVENT has a START-ON-EVENT-REF to a RUNNABLE-ENTITY, that RUNNABLE-ENTITY must not aggregate any WAIT-POINT.
For any RunnableEntity triggered by an InitEvent, minimumStartInterval must exist and equal 0.
For any RunnableEntity referenced by an InitEvent via START-ON-EVENT-REF, it must not aggregate an AsynchronousServerCallResultPoint.
InitEvent shall not have any DISABLED-MODE-IREF to a ModeDeclaration.
If DATA-ID-NIBBLE-OFFSET exists then DATA-ID-MODE must be 3 and CATEGORY must be PROFILE_01.
If ERROR-REACTION-POLICY is defaultMode then DEFAULT-MODE-REF must exist.
If SW-RECORD-LAYOUT-V-INDEX is 0 then CATEGORY must be VALUE or VAL_BLK.
Within a ClientServerOperationMapping, all mapped ArgumentDataPrototype instances must have identical direction.
For each ClientServerOperationMapping m: numArguments(firstOperation(m)) = numArguments(secondOperation(m)).
Within one ClientServerOperationMapping, each ArgumentDataPrototype is referenced at most once as firstDataPrototype or secondDataPrototype.
For a DataPrototype d typed by ApplicationRecordDataType t: numRecordElements(t) = numRecordFields(initRecordValue(d)).
If implCategory(implTypeOf(d)) = STRUCTURE then numSubElements(implTypeOf(d)) = numRecordFields2(initRecordValue2(d)).
For a DataPrototype d typed by ApplicationArrayDataType t: maxNumberOfElements(t) = numArrayElements(initArrayValue(d)).
If implArrayCategory(implArrayTypeOf(d)) = ARRAY then arraySize(implArrayTypeOf(d)) = numArrayElements2(initArrayValue2(d)).
If a VariableDataPrototype v is referenced by a VariableAccess in dataReceivePointByValue, then swImplPolicy(swDataDefProps(v)) != 'queued' (if SwDataDefProps present).
If two DATA-CONSTR instances are considered compatible (dataConstrsCompatible), then either neither has a unit reference in any physConstrs, or the referenced UNITs are unitsCompatible.
If swImplPolicyOfReceiver(SUBJECT) = SWIMPL_QUEUED, then for all DATA-ELEMENTs on the receiver side there shall be no unmapped elements (hasUnmappedElements(e) is false).
If hasUnmappedElements(dataElement) holds for a DATA-ELEMENT aggregated by a NONQUEUED-RECEIVER-COM-SPEC of an ABSTRACT-REQUIRED-PORT-PROTOTYPE, then has_initValue(dataElement, true) must hold.

For ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category VALUE with invalidInsideScope(t) = true, the INVALID-VALUE under SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT shall be an APPLICATION-VALUE-SPECIFICATION and not any other value specification type.

For ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category VALUE with invalidInsideScope(t) = true, the numeric value of the APPLICATION-VALUE-SPECIFICATION used as invalidValue must lie within the lower/upper limits of the applicable COMPU-METHOD scale (physToInternal or internalToPhys).
For any ApplicationPrimitiveDataType.swDataDefProps.invalidValue, neither REFERENCE-VALUE-SPECIFICATION nor RULE-BASED-VALUE-SPECIFICATION shall be used.

For ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category VALUE with invalidOutsideScope(t) = true, the INVALID-VALUE under SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT shall be a NUMERICAL-VALUE-SPECIFICATION and not any other value specification type.

If an AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPE uses TextValueSpecification and references a COMPU-METHOD via SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS/CONTENT/COMPU-METHOD-REF, then the COMPU-METHOD category must be one of TEXTTABLE, BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE, SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE, SCALE_RATIONAL_AND_TEXTTABLE.
If NV-BLOCK-DATA-MAPPING aggregates writtenNvData, the mapped PortPrototype must be an RPortPrototype; if writtenReadNvData, a PRPortPrototype; if readNvData, a PPortPrototype.
For an ARGUMENT-DATA-PROTOTYPE with direction in and typed by a primitive C data type, serverArgumentImplPolicy must not equal useVoid.
All VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPEs in one SENDER-RECEIVER-INTERFACE must share the same invalidationPolicy value.
For SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS whose DataPrototype is typed by an IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE, the combination of attributes must be allowed according to table 5.32.
For SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS whose DataPrototype is typed by an APPLICATION-DATA-TYPE, the combination of attributes must be allowed according to table 5.31.
Within one P-PORT-PROTOTYPE, for any given DATA-ELEMENT or CLIENT-SERVER-OPERATION there is at most one P-PORT-COM-SPEC that references it.
For each R-PORT-PROTOTYPE and each referenced DATA-ELEMENT or CLIENT-SERVER-OPERATION, there is at most one associated R-PORT-COM-SPEC.
For each PR-PORT-PROTOTYPE and each referenced DATA-ELEMENT or CLIENT-SERVER-OPERATION, there is at most one associated R-PORT-COM-SPEC and at most one associated P-PORT-COM-SPEC.

If a DATA-PROTOTYPE in a PORT-INTERFACE used by an ApplicationSwComponentType or SensorActuatorSwComponentType is typed/mapped to an IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE of category DATA_REFERENCE, then at least one provider or requester of that PORT-INTERFACE must be a ServiceSwComponentType, ComplexDeviceDriverSwComponentType, ParameterSwComponentType, NvBlockSwComponentType, or EcuAbstractionSwComponentType.
No VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE used as explicit or implicit inter-runnable variable may be typed/mapped to an IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE of category DATA_REFERENCE.

If SERVER-ARGUMENT-IMPL-POLICY is set to useArrayBaseType, the argument must be typed/mapped to an IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE of category ARRAY, or mapped to an APPLICATION-DATA-TYPE which is mapped to such an IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE.
If MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP.CATEGORY = EXPLICIT_ORDER, then ON-TRANSITION-VALUE and each MODE-DECLARATION.VALUE must be set.
If MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP.CATEGORY != EXPLICIT_ORDER, then ON-TRANSITION-VALUE and all MODE-DECLARATION.VALUE attributes must be unset.

If provider side AutosarDataPrototype is typed by VALUE (ApplicationPrimitiveDataType or ImplementationDataType VALUE/TYPE_REFERENCE->VALUE), then the DataPrototypeMapping shall not aggregate a SubElementMapping to an ImplementationDataTypeElement or ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype on the requester side.
For each SwcServiceDependency: if there exists a RoleBasedDataTypeAssignment with role='temporaryRamBlock', then there must not exist a RoleBasedDataAssignment with role='defaultValue'.
If a DataPrototypeMapping aggregates a TextTableMapping, only specific combinations of first/second CompuMethod.category (TEXTTABLE, SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE, BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE) are allowed.
BITFIELD-TEXT-TABLE-MASK-FIRST may exist only if the firstDataPrototype's CompuMethod.category is BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE.
BITFIELD-TEXT-TABLE-MASK-SECOND may exist only if the secondDataPrototype's CompuMethod.category is BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE.
For any TextTableMapping where both first and second CompuMethods have category BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE and at least one valuePair exists, IDENTICAL-MAPPING must be false.

If has_bitfieldTextTableMaskFirst or has_bitfieldTextTableMaskSecond then for all valuePairs[i], valueAllowedUnderMasks(SUBJECT, firstValue(vp)) and valueAllowedUnderMasks(SUBJECT, secondValue(vp)) must hold.
Iff: has_cyclicWritingPeriod(SUBJECT) <=> (has_storeCyclic(SUBJECT) and storeCyclic(SUBJECT) = true).
Iff: has_timingEventRef(SUBJECT) <=> (has_nvBlockNeeds(SUBJECT) and has_storeCyclic(nvBlockNeeds(SUBJECT)) and storeCyclic(nvBlockNeeds(SUBJECT)) = true).

For each SwcServiceDependency of an ApplicationSwComponentType: if serviceNeeds is implemented by NvBlockNeeds and any of storeCyclic, cyclicWritingPeriod, storeEmergency, storeImmediate exists, then there must exist an assignedPort with role = "NvDataPort".
For any MemorySection, among its OPTION values at most one isSafetyOption(option) is true.
For any SwAddrMethod, among its OPTION values at most one isSafetyOption(option) is true.

For each DataPrototypeMapping with sender CompuMethod category BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE, every TextTableMapping must cover each possible mask value exactly once via its TextTableValuePair.firstValue/secondValue depending on the applicable mask.

If dynamicArraySizeProfile(aadt) = VSA_LINEAR, then every contained ApplicationArrayElement must have arraySizeSemantics=variableSize, maxNumberOfElements defined, arraySizeHandling=allIndicesSameArraySize, and be typed by an ApplicationDataType that is not an ApplicationArrayDataType with its own dynamicArraySizeProfile.

If dynamicArraySizeProfile(aadt) = VSA_RECTANGULAR, the contained ApplicationArrayElement must have arraySizeSemantics=variableSize, maxNumberOfElements defined, arraySizeHandling=allIndicesSameArraySize, be typed by an ApplicationArrayDataType, and the referenced chain of nested ApplicationArrayDataTypes must satisfy VSARectangularChainOK.

If dynamicArraySizeProfile(aadt) = VSA_FULLY_FLEXIBLE, the contained ApplicationArrayElement must have arraySizeSemantics=variableSize, maxNumberOfElements defined, arraySizeHandling=allIndicesDifferentArraySize, be typed by an ApplicationArrayDataType, and the referenced chain of nested ApplicationArrayDataTypes must satisfy VSAFullyFlexibleChainOK.

If dynamicArraySizeProfile_impl(idt) = VSA_LINEAR, there must be a VSA Payload ImplementationDataTypeElement with category=ARRAY and no arraySize/arraySizeSemantics/arraySizeHandling, which immediately aggregates an inner element with arraySizeSemantics=variableSize, arraySize defined, arraySizeHandling=allIndicesSameArraySize.

If dynamicArraySizeProfile_impl(idt) = VSA_SQUARE, there must be a VSA Payload ImplementationDataTypeElement with category=ARRAY and no arraySize/arraySizeSemantics/arraySizeHandling, and a chain of aggregated ImplementationDataTypeElements satisfying VSASquareImplChainOK: first and intermediate elements with variableSize semantics, category=ARRAY, no arraySize, arraySizeHandling=inheritedFromArrayElementTypeSize, and a terminating element with variableSize semantics, arraySize defined, arraySizeHandling=allIndicesSameArraySize.

If dynamicArraySizeProfile = VSA_RECTANGULAR then there exists a VSA payload ImplementationDataTypeElement and a chain of ImplementationDataTypeElements with specific ARRAY / variableSize / allIndicesSameArraySize settings.
If dynamicArraySizeProfile = VSA_FULLY_FLEXIBLE then there exists a VSA payload ImplementationDataTypeElement with no arraySize/arraySizeSemantics/arraySizeHandling and a first dimension element.
If IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE has no dynamicArraySizeProfile but its mapped APPLICATION-ARRAY-DATA-TYPE has one, then IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE.category = STRUCTURE.
For any ReceiverComSpec that aggregates EndToEndTransformationDescription in transformationComSpecProps, usesEndToEndProtection shall be false.
If a DIAGNOSTIC-VALUE-NEEDS is aggregated by a SwcServiceDependency in role serviceNeeds, then DATA-LENGTH and DIAGNOSTIC-VALUE-ACCESS shall not exist.
If a DIAGNOSTIC-IO-CONTROL-NEEDS is aggregated by a SwcServiceDependency in role serviceNeeds, then FREEZE-CURRENT-STATE-SUPPORTED and SHORT-TERM-ADJUSTMENT-SUPPORTED shall not exist.
Existence of attributes of COMPU-METHOD and related meta-classes depends on CATEGORY according to Table 5.74; detailed rules to be encoded as additional SMT assertions.
For each MEMORY-SECTION, the list of OPTION values contains at most one of {"coreGlobal","coreLocal"}.
For each SW-ADDR-METHOD, the list of OPTION values contains at most one of {"coreGlobal","coreLocal"}.
Mutual exclusion: not (has_autosarVariable(x) and has_mcDataInstanceVar(x)).
If category_ImplDT(t) = TYPE_REFERENCE and (has_compuMethodRef or has_dataConstrRef) then category_FinalImplDT(finalImplType(t)) = VALUE.
If category_APDT(type_APDT(d)) is in {CURVE, MAP, CUBOID, CUBE_4, CUBE_5, COM_AXIS, RES_AXIS, VAL_BLK} then not has_invalidValue(d).
If a DataPrototype is typed by an IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE_2 then it shall not have an initValue provided by APPLICATION-VALUE-SPECIFICATION.
If a PORT-API-OPTION has at least one PORT-DEFINED-ARGUMENT-VALUE then its PORT-REF must resolve to an ABSTRACT-PROVIDED-PORT-PROTOTYPE typed by a CLIENT-SERVER-INTERFACE.
If category_VPP(v) = VALUE then not (yieldsPreBuildValue(v) and yieldsPostBuildValue(v)).

For each VariationPointProxy, the referenced ImplementationDataType must have category VALUE or TYPE_REFERENCE (resolving to VALUE) and must not be STRUCTURE/ARRAY/UNION/FUNCTION_REFERENCE/DATA_REFERENCE.
If handleInvalid != dontInvalidate then invalidValue must not lie in the interval defined by the associated CompuMethod.
If an ApplicationValueSpecification is assigned to an AutosarDataPrototype, then the unit of its SwValueCont must be compatible with the unit defined in the AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps.
If an ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification is assigned to an AutosarDataPrototype, then the unit of its SwValueCont must be compatible with the unit defined in the AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps.
For every RuleBasedValueCont, a UNIT-REF must be present (modeled as total function unitOf_RuleBasedValueCont).
If any NvBlockDataMapping exists for an NvDataInterface, then every VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE in NV-DATAS must be mapped by some NvBlockDataMapping.
For ImplementationDataTypeElements that are non-terminating and used to model a Variable-Size Array Data Type, category must not be TYPE_REFERENCE.
For each TRANSFORMER-HARD-ERROR-EVENT, exactly one of OPERATION-IREF or TRIGGER-IREF shall exist (mutual exclusion with totality).
If BASE-TYPE-ENCODING is UTF-16 then BYTE-ORDER shall exist and be either mostSignificantByteFirst or mostSignificantByteLast.
If CATEGORY exists for a MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP, it shall be either EXPLICIT_ORDER or ALPHABETIC_ORDER.

For each DATA-TRANSFORMATION, it may be referenced either by a DATA-PROTOTYPE-MAPPING (FIRST-TO-SECOND-DATA-TRANSFORMATION-REF) or by an I-SIGNAL (DATA-TRANSFORMATION-REF-CONDITIONAL) or by an I-SIGNAL-GROUP (COM-BASED-SIGNAL-GROUP-TRANSFORMATIONS/DATA-TRANSFORMATION-REF-CONDITIONAL), but not by more than one of these roles.

A VariableDataPrototype in the context of a PortPrototype shall not be simultaneously referenced by a DataPrototypeMapping with a DataTransformation and by a DataMapping that points to the same VariableDataPrototype and to an ISignal that also references a DataTransformation.
If SwAddrMethod.option or MemorySection.option is coreLocal then SwAddrMethod.sectionInitializationPolicy shall be INIT or CLEARED.
If an NV-BLOCK-DATA-MAPPING exists that directly and completely maps a specific nvData, then no other NV-BLOCK-DATA-MAPPING mapping sub-elements of that nvData shall exist.

For each SwcServiceDependency of an AtomicSwComponentType, all NvDataInterface.nvData of RoleBasedPortAssignments with role NvDataPort must be mapped via NvBlockDataMappings to NvBlockDescriptors that share the same RAM-BLOCK.
For each VARIABLE-ACCESS in DATA-READ-ACCESSS, the accessed variable must be via an RPortPrototype or PRPortPrototype whose interface is SenderReceiverInterface or NvDataInterface.
For each VARIABLE-ACCESS in DATA-WRITE-ACCESSS, the accessed variable must be via a PPortPrototype or PRPortPrototype whose interface is SenderReceiverInterface or NvDataInterface.
For each VARIABLE-ACCESS in DATA-SEND-POINTS, the accessed variable must be via a PPortPrototype or PRPortPrototype whose interface is SenderReceiverInterface or NvDataInterface.

For each VARIABLE-ACCESS in DATA-RECEIVE-POINT-BY-VALUES or DATA-RECEIVE-POINT-BY-ARGUMENTS, the accessed variable must be via an RPortPrototype or PRPortPrototype whose interface is SenderReceiverInterface or NvDataInterface.
Each AsynchronousServerCallPoint is referenced by exactly one AsynchronousServerCallResultPoint (existence and uniqueness).
Within one SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR, PerInstanceMemory elements that share the same TYPE must have the same TYPE-DEFINITION.
For each port of an NV-BLOCK-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: if it is not an RPort, it must be typed by NvDataInterface or ClientServerInterface; if it is an RPort, it must be typed by ModeSwitchInterface.
No SW-CONNECTOR may connect two ports whose owning SW-COMPONENT-PROTOTYPEs are both typed by NvBlockSwComponentType.

If a connector connects a port of a SwComponentPrototype typed by NvBlockSwComponentType, the opposite port must belong to a SwComponentPrototype typed by another AtomicSwComponentType and be typed by NvDataInterface or SenderReceiverInterface.
If ROM-BLOCK exists for an NV-BLOCK-DESCRIPTOR, the ImplementationDataType of RAM-BLOCK and ROM-BLOCK must be compatible.
ImplementationDataType of nvRamBlockElement must be compatible with ImplementationDataType of writtenNvData, writtenReadNvData, and readNvData if they are present.
ROLE must be one of the standardized AUTOSAR NVRAM Manager roles, e.g. NvMNotifyJobFinished or NvMNotifyInitBlock.

SwcInternalBehavior of NvBlockSwComponentType is restricted to certain event kinds and runnables; runnables must at least define symbol and canBeInvokedConcurrently and be triggered only by allowed events.
For any two connected PortPrototypes p1, p2, their owning SwComponentPrototypes shall not both be typed by ServiceProxySwComponentType.
If a PortPrototype belongs to a ServiceProxySwComponentType, then it is either an RPortPrototype typed by SenderReceiverInterface or a port typed by a PortInterface with isService=true.
For remote communication of ServiceProxySwComponentType, RPortPrototypes must be typed by SenderReceiverInterface and used in a 1:n scenario.
If a PortPrototype belongs to a ServiceSwComponentType, its PortInterface must have isService=true (ignoring documented exceptions).
If a VariableAccess is used as dataReadAccess, the swImplPolicy of the referenced VariableDataPrototype must not be queued.
A WaitPoint referencing a DataReceivedEvent is permitted iff the swImplPolicy of the referenced VariableDataPrototype is queued.
For each (ClientServerOperation, RPortPrototype) pair, it is referenced either by synchronous or by asynchronous server call points, but not both.
For all ServerCallPoints referencing the same (ClientServerOperation, RPortPrototype) pair, their TIMEOUT values must be equal.
If a PortAPIOption has ENABLE-TAKE-ADDRESS=true then the owning SwcInternalBehavior.supportsMultipleInstantiation must be false.

For VariableAccess in roles writtenLocalVariable/readLocalVariable, the LOCAL-VARIABLE-REF must point to a VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE owned by the same SwcInternalBehavior as the RunnableEntity and in role implicitInterRunnableVariable or explicitInterRunnableVariable.

For each ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT in a SwcServiceDependency of an ApplicationSwComponentType, the assigned PortPrototype must be typed by a PortInterface with isService=true, except for NV data management connections.
If a SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR has any STATIC-MEMORYS/VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE, then supportsMultipleInstantiation must be false.
SHORT-NAME must exist; equality to the C identifier is not enforced by SMT.

For each WAIT-POINT referencing an ASYNCHRONOUS-SERVER-CALL-RETURNS-EVENT, the owning RunnableEntity of the WAIT-POINT must equal the owning RunnableEntity of the ASYNCHRONOUS-SERVER-CALL-RESULT-POINT referenced by that event.
For each TIMING-EVENT, if PERIOD exists then its numeric value is > 0.
For a WaitPoint triggered by a DataSendCompletedEvent, the WaitPoint.TIMEOUT equals TransmissionAcknowledgementRequest.TIMEOUT of the associated SenderComSpec.
RunnableEntitys and BswSchedulableEntitys must not reference a SwAddrMethod whose memoryAllocationKeywordPolicy is addrMethodShortNameAndAlignment.
If a VariableDataPrototype belongs to a SenderReceiverInterface and has overriding swImplPolicy, then swImplPolicy must be one of {standard, queued, measurementPoint}.
If a VariableDataPrototype belongs to an NvDataInterface and has overriding swImplPolicy, then swImplPolicy must be standard.
If a VariableDataPrototype plays the role ramBlock and has overriding swImplPolicy, then swImplPolicy must be standard.
If a VariableDataPrototype plays the role implicitInterRunnableVariable and has overriding swImplPolicy, then swImplPolicy must be standard.
For all VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE in role explicitInterRunnableVariable: swImplPolicyOfVar(x) = standard.
For all VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE in role arTypedPerInstanceMemory: swImplPolicyOfVar(x) ∈ {standard, measurementPoint}.
For all VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE in role staticMemory: swImplPolicyOfVar(x) ∈ {standard, measurementPoint, message}.
For all PARAMETER-DATA-PROTOTYPE in ParameterInterface: swImplPolicyOfParam(p) ∈ {standard, const, fixed}.
For all PARAMETER-DATA-PROTOTYPE in role romBlock: swImplPolicyOfParam(p) = standard.
For all PARAMETER-DATA-PROTOTYPE in role sharedParameter: swImplPolicyOfParam(p) = standard.
For all PARAMETER-DATA-PROTOTYPE in role perInstanceParameter: swImplPolicyOfParam(p) = standard.
If a PARAMETER-DATA-PROTOTYPE has an overriding SW-IMPL-POLICY, its value must be one of {standard, const, fixed}.
If an ARGUMENT-DATA-PROTOTYPE has an overriding SW-IMPL-POLICY, its value must be standard.
If a SW-SERVICE-ARG has an overriding SW-IMPL-POLICY, its value must be standard or const.
Uniqueness: two MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP instances with the same SHORT-NAME must be identical.
Existence: every SW-AXIS-CONT must define exactly one SW-AXIS-INDEX and one SW-ARRAYSIZE.
If swValueCont is defined and the owning ApplicationValueSpecification category is in {CURVE, MAP, CUBOID, CUBE_4, CUBE_5, COM_AXIS, RES_AXIS, VAL_BLK}, then swArraysize must be defined.
For SW-AXIS-CONT, productOfArraySize(swArraysize) must equal numberOfValues(swValuesPhys).
For SW-VALUE-CONT, if both swArraysize and swValuesPhys are present, productOfArraySize(swArraysize) must equal numberOfValues(swValuesPhys).

For each SWC-SERVICE-DEPENDENCY with an OBD-RATIO-SERVICE-NEEDS: if connectionType = apiUse then there exists a ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT with role = IUMPRNumerator; if connectionType = observer then no ROLE-BASED-PORT-ASSIGNMENT with role = IUMPRNumerator may exist.
Any SYSTEM that is the target of a RPT-SYSTEM-REF shall have CATEGORY = RPT_SYSTEM.
Depending on RPT-CONTAINER.CATEGORY, the allowed targets of BY-PASS-POINT-IREF and RPT-AR-HOOK-IREF are restricted according to AUTOSAR table 13.4 (not fully encoded here).
Within one RAPID-PROTOTYPING-SCENARIO all RPT-SYSTEM-REF shall resolve to the same SYSTEM; if any RPT-AR-HOOK-IREF exist, they shall all resolve to the same other SYSTEM.
If swAxisCont is defined on the owning ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification, then for the RULE-BASED-AXIS-CONT both SW-ARRAYSIZE and SW-AXIS-INDEX must be defined.

If swValueCont is defined and the owning ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification has category in {CURVE, MAP, CUBOID, CUBE_4, CUBE_5, COM_AXIS, RES_AXIS, CURVE_AXIS, VAL_BLK, ARRAY}, then RULE-BASED-VALUE-CONT must define SW-ARRAYSIZE.

If AUTOSAR-PARAMETER-IREF is present in AUTOSAR-PARAMETER-REF and constr_1173 does not apply, the instance ref shall either target a PARAMETER-DATA-PROTOTYPE or an APPLICATION-COMPOSITE-ELEMENT-DATA-PROTOTYPE that is owned by a PARAMETER-DATA-PROTOTYPE.

If an AUTOSAR-VARIABLE-REF has AUTOSAR-VARIABLE-IREF, its instance-ref target shall either be a VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE or an APPLICATION-COMPOSITE-ELEMENT-DATA-PROTOTYPE owned by a VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE.

1) Limits of an ApplicationDataType must lie within the definition range of its CompuMethod. 2) Internal limits of the ApplicationDataType (after applying CompuMethod) must be within or equal to internalConstrs of the mapped ImplementationDataType. 3) Limits of the ImplementationDataType must be within or equal to the limits defined by the size of the BaseType.
If an ImplementationDataType has an INVALID-VALUE, that value must lie within the range defined by its internalConstrs.

If both SwDataDefPropsContent.dataConstr and SwDataDefPropsContent.valueAxisDataType.swDataDefProps.dataConstr exist, then the value range of dataConstr must be a subset of the value axis dataConstr range (no relaxation).
For an SW-AXIS-INDIVIDUAL, if units are specified via inputVariableType, compuMethod, or UNIT-REF, they must be mutually compatible (modeled as equality of UNIT references).
For a value axis (SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONTENT), if units are specified via valueAxisDataType, compuMethod, or UNIT-REF, all these units shall be the same (modeled as equality of UNIT references).
If CONSTR-LEVEL is present on a DATA-CONSTR-RULE, its value must be 0 (hard limit) or 1 (soft limit).
For any two connected ports that both use the same ModeSwitchInterface, their ECU placements must be equal.
Within one DATA-TYPE-MAPPING-SET, each MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP is mapped to at most one IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE.
If activation is onTransition then the event has exactly two distinct MODE-DECLARATION references belonging to the same MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP; otherwise exactly one MODE-DECLARATION reference.
Each SENDER-RECEIVER-ANNOTATION is owned by a PORT-PROTOTYPE that is typed by a SENDER-RECEIVER-INTERFACE.
Each CLIENT-SERVER-ANNOTATION is owned by a PORT-PROTOTYPE that is typed by a CLIENT-SERVER-INTERFACE.
Each PARAMETER-PORT-ANNOTATION is owned by a P-PORT-PROTOTYPE that in turn is owned by a PARAMETER-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE.
Each MODE-PORT-ANNOTATION is owned by a PORT-PROTOTYPE that is typed by a MODE-SWITCH-INTERFACE.
For every TRIGGER-PORT-ANNOTATION, its parent PortPrototype must be typed by a TRIGGER-INTERFACE.
For every NV-DATA-PORT-ANNOTATION, its parent PortPrototype must be typed by an NV-DATA-INTERFACE.
For every DELEGATED-PORT-ANNOTATION, its parent PortPrototype must belong to some COMPOSITION-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE.
For each MODE-SWITCHED-ACK-EVENT, timeoutOfWaitPoint(waitPointOfEvent(e)) must equal timeoutOfRequest(requestOfEvent(e)).
Any VALUE-SPECIFICATION used to assign a value to a software object typed by an AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPE must fit into that AUTOSAR-DATA-TYPE.
For any RUNNABLE-ENTITY, the optional REENTRANCY-LEVEL shall not be set: not hasReentrancyLevel(r).
